1.title: Yini Isheya?
1.content: Cabanga bona wena nabangani bakho abali-9 nifaka ngamunye u-{c}10 bona nithenge iinsetjhe ezibiza u-{c}100 ndawonye. Ngamunye wenu unesabelo esingu-1/10 saleyo nsetjhe, begodu lokho kuyisheya ngambala! Nawuthenga isheya ku-{retail}, ube nesiqetjhana esincani sesitolo ngasinye, somkhiqizo ngamunye, nesemali yoke abayenzako (imali: {cName}). Nayikhula khulu inkampani, isiqetjhana sakho siba nevalu ephezulu! 🔥

quiz.q: Wena nabangani bakho aba-4 nihlukanisa ngokulinganako intengo yesihlalo sokudlala amageyimu esibiza u-{c}500. Ngamunye wenu unani?
quiz.explanation: Ukuba nesheya kutjho ukuba nengcenye yento yoke. Abantu abahlanu ababhadala ngokulinganako batjho iinqetjhana ezihlanu ezilinganako, begodu isiqetjhana ngasinye sinamalungelo afanako nezinye.
options: Ngamunye u-1/5 (20%) wesihlalo
Akunalitho, ngumuntu munye kwaphela ongaba naso
Isihlalo soke ndawonye, kungekho sabelo somuntu ngamunye

2.title: I-{ex} Ihlathululwa
2.content: Cabanga nge-{ex} ({exFull}) njengemakethe ekulu ye-inthanethi, ngaphandle kobana esikhundleni sokuthenga iinsetjhe namkha amafoni, abantu bathenga begodu bathengise iinqetjhana ezincani (amasheya) zeenkampani ezifana ne-{top5}. Ivulwa qobe langa lomsebenzi ngaphandle kwamalanga womphakathi wokuphumula, begodu iintengo ziyatjhuguluka ilanga loke kuya ngokobana ngubani othengako nokobana ngubani othengisako. I-{ex} {exDesc}! 🌍

quiz.q: I-{ex} ifana khulu nani?
quiz.explanation: Imakethe yamasheya ihlanganisa abantu abafuna ukuthenga amasheya nalabo abafuna ukuwathengisa. Ayinawo amasheya, ayikhethi intengo, begodu angekhe ikubhadale inzalo ngokutjhiya imali kiyo.
options: Imakethe, lapho abanikazi bamasheya bahlangana nabathengi
I-akhawundu yokubulunga, lapho imali ihlala khona ithole inzalo
Isitolo esinamasheya esiwathengisela wena

3.title: Iinkunzi nemaBhere
3.content:
Emakethe, iinlwana ziphethe izinto 😄

🐂 Inkunzi = iintengo ziyakhuphuka. Cabanga inkunzi igijima iya phezulu ngeempondo zayo. Woke umuntu uyazuza, abantu bayathenga, umoya uhle.

🐻 Ibhere = iintengo ziyehla. Cabanga ibhere lirhabula liye phasi ngelozwana lalo. Abantu bayasaba, bayathengisa, akusisikhathi esihle.

Nangabe othileko uthi 'Ngiyinkunzi nge-{tech}', ucabanga bona intengo izakukhuphuka. Nathi 'ngilibhere', ucabanga bona iya phasi. Uzawezwa amagama la kizo zoke iindawo zeemali!

quiz.q: Umngani wakho uthi 'Ngilibhere nge-{telco} kule veke.' Lokho kutjho ukuthini?
quiz.explanation: Ukuba libhere kutjho ukulindela bona intengo izakwehla, ukuba yinkunzi kutjho ukulindela bona izakukhuphuka. Ibhere lirhabula liye phasi, inkunzi iphosa phezulu.
options: Bacabanga bona intengo ye-{telco} izakukhuphuka
Bacabanga bona intengo ye-{telco} izakwehla
Bafuna ukuthenga i-{telco} enengi kangangokobana kungenzeka

4.title: Yini IBhulokha?
4.content:
Awukghoni ukuvele ukhambe uye ku-{retail} uthi 'ngiphe ingcenye yenkampani yakho bewuthi' 😂 Utlhoga ibhulokha: i-app namkha umsebenzi ohlanganisa abathengi nabathengisi emakethe yamasheya.

Cabanga ngebhulokha njengo-{shop}. Ufuna okuthileko, u-{shop} ukuhlanganisa nakho. Bona baphatha ukuthenga begodu babiza imbadelo encani. Amabhulokha athandwako e-{name} afaka u-{broker} nabanye.

Nakhu okungenziwa libhulokha: ukuqunta bona ngimaphi amasheya azakukhuphuka. Lidlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe. Intengo iyatjhuguluka ngebanga lalokho woke umuntu ngaphandle akuthengako nakuthengisako, ingasi ngombana ibhulokha lakho litjho njalo.

Kodwana amabhulokha ayawabeka phambili amazizwa wawo. Abahlathululi bawo bakala amasheya ngokuthi 'thenga', 'bamba' namkha 'thengisa'. Umbono akusi-oda 🤷 Abahlathululi abavumelani ngokusobala ngesheya elifanako, begodu banengi abagcina bephosiwe. Funda isilinganiso njengombono, ingasi umthetho.

I-NoobTrader ikufundisa bona lokhu kusebenza njani ncamancama, simahla, ngemali elingisiweko!

quiz.q: Kubayini utlhoga ibhulokha bona uthenge amasheya?
quiz.explanation: Ibhulokha yindlela yakho yokungena emakethe yamasheya, ingasi umbikezeli wekusasa begodu ingasi obeka intengo. Lidlulisela i-oda phambili, begodu intengo ngileyo enye imakethe ezimisele ukurhweba ngayo. Abahlathululi balo babeka iinlinganiso, kodwana isilinganiso mbono, ingasi umyalo.
options: Bakhetha amasheya azakukhuphuka
Babeka intengo oyibhadalako ngesheya ngalinye
Badlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe yamasheya

5.title: Iinsisekelo Zentengo Yesheya
5.content:
Wakhe wabona bona iinsetjhe ezenziwe zingakanani zenyuka njani ngentengo nazikhutjhwako? Kwenzeka khona lokho namasheya. Koke kumayelana nokutholakala nokufunwa.

📈 Abantu abanengi bafuna ukuthenga → intengo iyakhuphuka
📉 Abantu abanengi bafuna ukuthengisa → intengo iyehla

Nangabe i-{telco} imemezela bona ifumana amakhasimende amatjha ayi-10 million, woke umuntu ufuna isiqetjhana, ngalokho intengo iyatjhaya phezulu. Nayibika ilahleko ekulu, abantu bathengisa ngokwesaba begodu intengo iyehla. Iindaba, imiphumela, ngitjho neenthrendi zama-social media zingatjhugulula iintengo zamasheya msinyana!

quiz.q: I-{retail} imemezela inzuzo ephezulu engakhenge yabonwe begodu ihlela ukuvula iintolo ezitjha ezima-50. Kungenzeka kwenzekeni ngentengo yesheya layo?
quiz.explanation: Inzuzo elindelwe ebhedere kanengi itjho abathengi abanengi, begodu abathengi abanengi badudulela intengo phezulu. Ukusebenzisa imali bona ukhule akufani nokuyimosha.
options: Iyakhuphuka njengombana abantu abanengi bafuna ukuthenga
Ihlala injalo ncamancama
Iyawa ngombana basebenzisa imali eentolo

6.title: Ukufunda Itjhati Lentengo
6.content:
Itjhati lentengo lifana nevidiyo yeengcenye eziqakathekileko zomlando wesheya. Uhlobo oluthandwa khulu litjhati lamakhendlela. 'Ikhendlela' ngalinye likutjengisa izinto ezi-4 zelanga elilodwa:

🟢 Ikhendlela eliluhlaza = intengo ikhuphukile ngelo langa (ivulwe iphasi, yavalwa iphezulu)
🔴 Ikhendlela elibomvu = intengo yehlile (ivulwe iphezulu, yavalwa iphasi)
📏 Imigca emincani ngaphezulu/ngaphasi = iintengo eziphezulu neziphasi khulu zelanga

Nawubona amakhendlela amanengi aluhlaza alandelanako, lokho kukhuphuka okunamandla. Amanengi abomvu atjho ukwehla. Ukufunda ukufunda amatjhati kufana nokufunda ukufunda ibhodo lamaphuzu lomdlalo! 🎮

quiz.q: Ubona amakhendlela abomvu ama-5 alandelanako etjhatini. Lokhu kukutjelani?
quiz.explanation: Ikhendlela elibomvu livala ngaphasi kwalapho livulele khona, ngalokho amahlanu alandelanako masesheni amahlanu wokwehla. Umbala ukutjela isiyo, ingasi ubukhulu bokutjhuguluka.
options: Isheya belikhuphuka amalanga ama-5
Isheya belehla amalanga ama-5
Intengo yesheya ayikhenge itjhuguluke

7.title: Ivolumu Nalokho Ekutjhoko
7.content:
Ivolumu = mangakanani amasheya athengiweko athengiswa ngelanga. Cabanga ngayo njengokubukwa kwevidiyo ye-TikTok.

🔊 Ivolumu ePHEZULU = abantu abanengi bayarhweba. Nangabe intengo itjhuguluka nevolumu ephezulu, lokho kuyitshwayo elinamandla nelithembekako khudlwana, njengevidiyo ethandwa ngambala ngabantu, ingasi ngamabhothi.

🔇 Ivolumu ePHASI = mbalwa kwaphela abantu abarhwebako. Iintengo zingatjhuguluka ngendlela erarako nevolumu iphasi, njengevidiyo ebukwe kathathu kwaphela eyabelwana ngayo ngephoso.

Hlala uhlola ivolumu nawubona intengo itjhuguluka khulu. Ikutjela nange ukutjhuguluka kwamambala namkha kumsindo nje!

quiz.q: Isheya le-{telco} lenyuka nge-5% namhlanje, kodwana ivolumu iphasi khulu. Kufuze ucabangeni?
quiz.explanation: Ivolumu ikutjela bona kunokuqiniseka okungangani ngemva kokutjhuguluka. Ukwenyuka okukhulu ngokurhweba okuncani kungabuyiselwa emva lula njengombana kwenzekile, ngalokho hlola ivolumu ngaphambi kokukholwa ukuphunyuka kwentengo.
options: Kuthuba elikhulu ngambala, thenga njesi!
Ivolumu ephasi ihlala itjho bona intengo izakuragela phambili ikhuphuka
Ukutjhuguluka kungaba kungathembeki, ivolumu ephasi yenza kusolise

8.title: Isekelo Nomzabalazo
8.content:
Cabanga bona intengo yesheya libhola elitjhaba phezulu:

🧱 ISEKELO = iphasi ibhola elitjhaba kilo. Intengo iragela phambili yehla kodwana qobe nayifika kilelizinga, iyatjhaba ibuyele phezulu. Abathengi abanengi bavela lapha.

🪟 UMZABALAZO = isilingi ibhola eliyithintako. Qobe intengo nayikhuphukela kilelizinga, iyadudulelwa emuva phasi. Abathengisi abanengi bathatha imali yabo lapha.

Abarhwebi basebenzisa amazinga la njengemaphu yomdlalo: thenga eduze nephasi, thengisa eduze nesilingi. Nangabe intengo ekugcineni idlula emzabalazweni, kanengi itjhaya phezulu msinyana. Nayidlula isekelo, zilungiselele ukwehla! 💥

Isiyeleliso esimsulwa: amazinga la adwetjwa babantu abaqala amatjhati, akusiyimithetho imakethe ekufuze iyilalele. Isheya lingaqhekeza ngqo ngehla 'kwesekelo' liragele phambili. 📉

quiz.q: Isheya litjhabe ku-{c}50 kathathu ngaphandle kokwehla ngaphasi kwakho. U-{c}50 ubizwa ngokuthini?
quiz.explanation: Iphasi elihlala lihlonitjhwa yisekelo; isilingi esihlala sala intengo mzabalazo. Akukho nesisodwa esisithembiso, kodwana kokubili kufanele ukwazeke ngaphambi kobana uthenge.
options: Izinga lesekelo
Izinga lomzabalazo
Intengo yesilingi

9.title: Ukwahlukanisa Ukutjala
9.content:
Cabanga bona usebenzisa YOKE i-data bundle yakho ku-app yinye yokustrima. Bese leyo app iyawa. Usala ungasenalitho. 😩

Kodwana nawuhlukanisa i-data yakho ku-WhatsApp, YouTube, NE-app yakho yokustrima, ukuwa kweyodwa akonakalisi umoya wakho woke.

Kufana nokutjala imali! Nawufaka YOKE imali yakho esheyeni elilodwa begodu liwa, ulahlekelwa yikho koke. Kodwana nawuyihlukanisa ku-{telco} (ezokuthintana), ku-{retail} (ezokuthengisa), ku-{tech} (ezobuthekhnoloji), naku-ETF, ukuwa kweyodwa akubulali iphothifoliyo yakho yoke. Leli qhinga lokuhlukanisa libizwa ngokobana KUKWAHLUKANISA UKUTJALA (diversification). 💼

quiz.q: Uno-{c}500 wokutjala. Ngikuphi kilokhu okuhlukanisa ingozi yakho ngambala?
quiz.explanation: Iintolo zezambatho ezihlanu zoke zikhuphuka ziwe ngebanga lento efanako, ngalokho imali ehlukaniswe kizo ayikahlukaniswa nakancani. Iimboni ezihlukeneko zifikelwa yimiraro ngeenkhathi ezihlukeneko, begodu lokho kuvimba umphumela omumbi owodwa ukuthatha koke.
options: U-{c}100 ngamunye eentolweni zezambatho ezihlanu ezihlukeneko
U-{c}100 ngamunye eembonini ezihlanu ezihlukeneko
Woke u-{c}500 enkampanini yinye oyithanda khulu

10.title: Ingozi Nomvuzo
10.content:
Wakhe wathenga ibhokisi elingaziwako? Ungathola into ehle khulu, namkha iseleni elipheleleko. Lokho yingozi ephezulu / umvuzo ophezulu.

Ukutjala imali kusebenza ngendlela efanako:

✅ INGOZI EPHASI, UMVUZO OPHASI: Njenge-{retail}. Inkampani ekulu khulu, esele isimeme. Imali yakho ivamise ukukhula kancani begodu kuhle. Qaphela 'ephasi', ingasi 'ayikho'. Iinkampani ezikulu nazo ziyawa.

🎲 INGOZI EPHEZULU, UMVUZO OPHEZULU: Njengenkampani encani etjha yokumba. Ingaphindeka ka-10, namkha inyamalale. Njengebhokisi elingaziwako.

Ngaphambi kokutjala nanyana yini, hlala ubuza: 'Yini embi khulu engenzeka?' Nawungekhe ukghone ukulahlekelwa yiyo, ungayithathi ingozi!

quiz.q: Ikhoyini engaziwa mumuntu ithembisa imbuyiselo ye-500%. Isithembiso esikhulu kangako sikutjelani ngambala?
quiz.explanation: Ingozi nomvuzo mamaphethelo amabili wenduku efanako. Akakho umuntu onikela nge-500% ngaphandle kwesizathu, ngalokho ubukhulu besithembiso kulinganisa ngambala bona imali yoke inganyamalala lula kangangani. Ngaphambi kokufaka imali kinanyana yini, buza bona isimo esimbi khulu sibonakala njani nokobana ungaphila naso na.
options: Yintengo ehle imakethe yoke engakhenge iyibone ngandlela thize
Nasikhulu isithembiso, abantu abangemva kwaso baqinile khudlwana
Ithuba lokulahlekelwa koke likhulu njengesithembiso

11.title: Isikhathi Eside Nesikhathi Esifitjhani
11.content:
🏃 UKURHWEBA KWESIKHATHI ESIFITJHANI: Ukuthenga nokuthengisa ngemalangeni namkha eemvekeni bona ubambe ukutjhuguluka kwentengo okusheshako. Kunegandelelo elikhulu, kutlhoga isikhathi esinengi uqale isikrini. Kufana nokulinga ukubikezela bona ngubani ozakuhlula umdlalo ngamunye emncintiswaneni.

🧘 UKUTJALA KWESIKHATHI ESIDE: Ukuthenga amasheya nokuwabamba iminyaka. Uyakghodlhelela ukwehla begodu uvumele imali yakho ikhule. Kufana nokubheja ngokobana ngisiphi isiqhema esizakuhlula isizini yoke. Awusabi ngemva komdlalo owodwa omumbi.

Iimfundo zama-akhawundu wamambala wamabhulokha zihlala zifumana isibonelo esifanako: nabantu barhweba kanengi, kulapho benza kumbi khona ngemva kokubalwa kwemibadelo.

Begodu isikhathi yinzuzo yinye engekhe ithengwe godu ngemva kwalokho. Umnyaka ngamunye imali ehlala itjaliwe ngomunye umnyaka wokuthi i-compounding isebenze. ⏳

quiz.q: Abantu ababili bathenga amasheya afanako ngemali efanako. Omunye ungena aphume qobe veke, omunye uyawatjhiya iminyaka elitjhumi. Iimfundo zama-akhawundu wamambala zihlala zifumanani?
quiz.explanation: Ukurhweba ngakunye kubiza okuthileko, begodu leyo mbadelo iyaphuma kungakhathaliseki bona ukurhweba kusebenzile namkha awa. Ifundo emva kwefundo yama-akhawundu wamambala wamabhulokha ifumana isibonelo esifanako: nabantu barhweba kanengi, kulapho basalela khona emva. Ukutjhiya imali kunjalo akusibuvila, kulihlelo elitjipileko.
options: Lowo omajadu kanengi ugcina asemva ngemva kokubalwa kwemibadelo
Lowo omajadu kanengi kanengi uyahlula, ngombana ukuzikhandla kuyavuzwa lapha
Bagcina balingana, ngombana babambe amasheya afanako ncamancama

12.content:

📉 Lokha iintengo ziPHASI → u-{c}100 wakho uthenga amasheya AMANENGI
📈 Lokha iintengo ziPHEZULU → u-{c}100 wakho uthenga amasheya AMBALWA

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intengo yakho ephakathi ngesheya iyalingana begodu 'uthenga ukwehla' ngokuzenzakalelako ngaphandle kokulinga! Lokhu kubizwa ngokobana yi-{dcaTitle} ({dcaAbbrev}). Kususa imizwa ekutjaleni imali ngombana awusatlhogi ukuqunta bona 'NJESI yisikhathi esifaneleko na?' Uvele uzibophe bewuragele phambili! 💪

Iqiniso elinqophileko: lokhu angekhe kuhlale kuhlula ukufaka imali yoke ngesikhathi sinye. Okwenzako kukwenza ihlelo ongakghona ukunamathela kilo ngambala.

quiz.q: Ufaka u-200 NT lokha isheya libiza u-100 NT. Isheya bese liyawa, begodu u-200 NT wakho olandelako ungena ngo-25 NT. Dosela entengweni yakho ephakathi ngesheya kizo zoke iinkhokhelo ezimbili.
quiz.explanation: U-200 NT wakho wokuthoma uthenge amasheya ama-2 ngo-100 NT. U-200 NT wakho wesibili uthenge amasheya ama-8 ngo-25 NT. Lokho ngu-400 NT ngamasheya ali-10, ngalokho ngu-40 NT ngalinye. Qaphela bona akukho eduze nehlangothi hlangana kweentengo ezimbili: imali efanako ngokuzenzakalelako ithenga okunengi lokha izinto zitjipile, begodu yikho lokho okudosela intengo yakho ephakathi phasi.

13.title: Iinsana Zemali 💸
13.content:
Cabanga bona unomtjhini wokuthengisa. Qobe veke, abantu bathenga amasnekhi emtjhinini WAKHO, begodu wena uqoqa imali, ngombana nje unawo. Akukho okhunye obekufuze ukwenze!

Lokho kumadividendi. Siwabiza ngokobana Ziinsana Zemali 🍼 ngombana imali yakho ibeletha iinsana ngambala: iinkhokhelo ezincani zemali ezingena e-akhawundwini yakho ngombana nje unamasheya.

Iinkampani ezikulu ezifana ne-{divPayers} zibhadala Iinsana Zemali ngokujayelekileko. Nawubamba amasheya amanengi, iinsana zakho ziba zikulu!

⚠️ AZIKAQINISEKISWA. Inkampani iqunta qobe nakufika isikhathi bona izakubhadala na, begodu ingayehlisa idividendi namkha iyijamise ngokupheleleko lokha ibhizinisi libudisi. Ukubhadala okukhulu nyakanje akusisithembiso sokubhadala nyakenye.

Begodu nawutjala godu iinsana lezo bona uthenge amasheya AMANENGI... iqoqo lakho elilandelako likhulu khudlwana. Ijikelezo elihle 🔁

quiz.q: I-{bank} ikubhadala u-{c}5 ngesheya ngalinye onalo, ngaphandle kobana uthengise litho. Leyo nkhokhelo ibizwa ngokuthini?
quiz.explanation: Idividendi yingcenye yenzuzo yenkampani enikelwa kilabo abanayo. Le-app iyibiza ngokobana Ziinsana Zemali. Uhlala unamasheya woke obunawo, begodu imali isangena e-akhawundwini yakho. Kodwana ayithenjisiwe, begodu inkampani ingayehlisa namkha iyijamise nanini nalokha ibhizinisi libudisi.
options: Idividendi, isiqetjhana senzuzo
Inzalo, efana naleyo i-akhawundu yokubulunga eyibhadalako
Ibhonasi yokuthembeka ngokuba likhasimende

14.title: Inzalo Ehlanganiswako
14.content:
Nasi isifihlo semali esinamandla khulu ozakhe usifunde. Ulungile? 👀

Utjala u-{c}1,000 nge-10% ngomnyaka:
• Umnyaka 1: {c}1,000 → {c}1,100 (uzuze u-{c}100)
• Umnyaka 2: {c}1,100 → {c}1,210 (uzuze u-{c}110, ngaphezu komnyaka 1!)
• Umnyaka 3: {c}1,210 → {c}1,331 (uzuze u-{c}121)

Njesi uzuza inzalo enzalweni YAKHO. Ibhola leqhwa liya likhula qobe mnyaka ngaphandle kobana wengeze litho. Ngemva kweminyaka ema-30 nge-10%? Lowo {c}1,000 uba ngu-{c}17,449! 🤯

Uzakubona lokhu kubizwa ngokobana 'yimangaliso yobunane yephasi' begodu kuthiwe kwatjhiwo ngu-Einstein. Abukho ubufakazi bamambala bokuthi wakhe wakutjho, kodwana izibalo ziyingcenye eqakathekileko, begodu izibalo zingezamambala. Thoma msinyana, isikhathi sikwenzele umsebenzi obudisi.

quiz.q: Ufaka u-2,000 NT nge-10% ngomnyaka begodu awukhe uyithinte. Dosela kilokho ekufanele khona ngemva kweminyaka emithathu.
quiz.explanation: Umnyaka wokuthoma wengeza u-200 NT, okwenza u-2,200. Umnyaka wesibili uthatha i-10% ka-2,200, ngalokho wengeza u-220 begodu wenza u-2,420. Umnyaka wesithathu wengeza u-242 begodu ufika ku-2,662. Qobe mnyaka i-10% ibalwa enqwabeni ekulu khudlwana, yikho ukwengeza u-200 kathathu ujame ku-2,600 kungafiki.

15.title: I-Compounding Namasheya
15.desc: Ukutjala godu Iinsana Zemali bona ukhule
15.content:
Uyakhumbula Iinsana Zemali (amadividendi)? Nakhu lapho kuba mnandi khona 🤯

Okujayelekileko: Uzuza u-{c}50 Weensana Zemali → uwusebenzisela amasnekhi → kuphelile.

Igadango elihlakaniphileko: Uzuza u-{c}50 Weensana Zemali → uthenga amasheya AMANENGI → ngesikhathi esilandelako uthola Iinsana Zemali EZINENGI → uthenga amasheya amanengi khudlwana → ibhola leqhwa liya 🔝

Lokhu yi-compounding esetjenziswa emasheyeni. Bala izibalo: faka inani elifanako qobe nyanga iminyaka ema-30 ngembuyiselo ephakathi ye-10%, begodu ugcina unokuphindeka KASITHANDATHU kwalokho okufakileko ngambala. Pheze iingcenye ezihlanu kweziyisithandathu zaleyo nqwaba kukukhula: imali ongakhenge uyisebenzele, uyibulunge namkha uyifake.

Esikhathini eside, amadividendi atjalwe godu enze ingcenye ekulu yembuyiselo yoke yabatjali. Yikho kanye lokho iinkampani 'ezidinako' ezibhadala amadividendi zigcina zingadinanga nakancani 💰

quiz.q: Uzuza u-{c}80 wamadividendi begodu usebenzisa yoke isenti yawo ukuthenga amasheya amanengi esikhundleni sokuwasebenzisa. Kwenzekani ekubhadaleni okulandelako?
quiz.explanation: Isheya ngalinye elengeziweko olithengileko libhadala idividendi yalo ngesikhathi esilandelako, ngalokho ukubhadala kuyakhula ngaphandle kobana wengeze imali etjha. Leyo yi-compounding godu, kwanje isebenza ngemali engenako kunokobana ibe ngentengo.
options: Ukubhadala kuhlala kunobukhulu obufanako, kufika ngemva kwalokho nje
Uthola okuncani ngesikhathi esilandelako, ngombana ubuyisele imali
Unamasheya amanengi, ngalokho ukubhadala okulandelako kukhulu

16.title: Umthetho Ka-72
16.content:
Nali iqhinga elifitjhani lobuchopho bakho 🧠

Ufuna ukwazi bona kuthatha isikhathi esingangani ukuPHINDA imali yakho kabili? Vele uhlukanise u-72 ngembuyiselo yakho yomnyaka:

• 72 ÷ 12% wembuyiselo = iminyaka eyi-6 bona iphindeke
• 72 ÷ 8% wembuyiselo = iminyaka eyi-9 bona iphindeke
• 72 ÷ 6% wembuyiselo = iminyaka eli-12 bona iphindeke

Ngalokho nawuzuza i-12% ehlala injalo ngomnyaka ku-{c}2,000, eminyakeni eyi-6 unalo u-{c}4,000. Linda eminye iminyaka eyi-6 begodu unalo u-{c}8,000. Eminye eyi-6 begodu unalo u-{c}16,000! 🤯

Kulinganiso, ingasi umthetho, begodu iimbuyiselo zamambala azikhe zibe linani elihlala lifanako qobe mnyaka. Kodwana kusondele ngokwaneleko bona ukwenze ngehloko, yikho okuqakathekileko.

Yikho ukuthoma uneminyaka eli-13 namkha eli-14 kuyinto EKULU. Unemijikelezo yokuphindeka eminengi phambi kwakho ukudlula pheze nanyana ngubani omunye!

quiz.q: Ukutjala kuzuza i-9% ngomnyaka. Sebenzisa Umthetho Ka-72 bona udosele eminyakeni ekuthatha bona iphindeke kabili.
quiz.explanation: Hlukanisa u-72 ngephesenti lomnyaka. U-72 ohlukaniswe ngo-9 ngu-8, ngalokho imali iphindeka kabili pheze eminyakeni eyi-8, bese iphindeka godu ngemva kweminyaka eyi-8. Kulinganiso esheshako ongakwenza ngehloko, ingasi umthetho onqophileko, ngombana iimbuyiselo zamambala azikhe zibe linani elifanako qobe mnyaka.

17.title: Ama-oda Wemakethe Nomkhawulo
17.content:

Ama-oda womkhawulo akunikela amandla phezu kwentengo. Ama-oda wemakethe akunikela isiqiniseko sokobana lizaliseka. Awukghoni ukuba nakho kokubili! 💸

Nawuthengisa, ubiza intengo ENGAPHEZULU. Umbono ofanako, ihlangothi elihlukileko. 🔁

quiz.explanation: I-oda lemakethe lizaliseka msinyana ngananyana ngiyiphi intengo ekhona. I-oda lomkhawulo libiza intengo yakho bese liyalinda, ngalokho i-app iqala esikhundleni sakho. Lokha intengo ozakuyamukela iqakatheke khulu kunokungena msinyana, ngilo olifunako.

19.title: Ama-oda we-Stop-Loss
19.content:
I-stop-loss ifana nokubeka umkhawulo wokobana uzimisele ukulahlekelwa kangangani: ilifu lokuvikela olibeka ngaphambili.

Isibonelo: Uthenga amasheya we-{telco} ngo-{c}100 ngalinye. Uqunta bona AWUKHE ufune ukulahlekelwa ngaphezu kwe-15%. Ngalokho ubeka i-stop-loss ku-{c}85.

Nangabe i-{telco} yehlela ku-{c}85 → i-oda lokuthengisa liyaqalisa ngokuzenzakalelako. Awutlhogi ukuqala, begodu awutlhogi ukwenza isiqunto lokha usabile.

Nasi isiqephu abantu abasiphosako. Inani le-stop-loss LIHLALA lingaphasi kwentengo yanamhlanje. Kufuze kube njalo, ngombana intengo kufuze yehle bona ilifikelele. Libeke ngaphezu kwentengo yanamhlanje begodu sele liliqiniso, ngalokho lithengisa ngasikhatjhana olibeka ngaso, ngentengo yanamhlanje. Lokho kukuthengisa, ingasi ilifu lokuvikela.

Ungalidideli nomkhawulo wokuthengisa. Kokubili kuyathengisa ngokuzenzakalelako ngentengo oyikhethileko. Umahluko sisiyo: i-stop-loss iqalisa lokha intengo YEHLELA enanini lakho, umkhawulo wokuthengisa uqalisa lokha IKHUPHUKELA enanini lakho. Ukuzivikela → inani lakho liya ngaphasi. Ukubiza intengo yakho → inani lakho liya ngaphezulu. Zibuze bona wenza yiphi ngaphambi kokutayipha. 🧭

⚠️ Into ekulu: i-stop-loss iqalisa UKUTHENGISA, ayiqinisekisi INTENGO. Nangabe iindaba ezimbi zifika ebusuku begodu isheya livula ngo-{c}70 lingakhange lirhwebe ku-{c}85, i-oda lakho lizaliseka ngananyana ngiyiphi intengo imakethe ezimisele ukuyibhadala ngambala. Lokho kungaba ngaphasi khulu kwezinga olibekileko.

Ngaphandle kwe-stop-loss nakancani, ungabambelela uthemba bona izakubuyela... bewuyiqale yehlela ku-{c}20. 😬

Iseluleko sengcwethi: Hlala uqunta ilahleko yakho ephezulu ngaphambi kobana uthenge. Ungavumeli imizwa yenze leso siqunto lokha intengo sele iwa! 🧘

quiz.q: Uthenga ngo-200 NT begodu uqunta bona awuzimiselanga ukulahlekelwa ngaphezu kwe-15% kilo. Dosela entengweni lapho i-stop-loss yakho kufuze ibe khona.
quiz.explanation: I-15% ka-200 NT ngu-30 NT, ngalokho ukuphuma kwakho kungaphasi ngo-30 kwalapho uthenge khona, ku-170 NT. I-stop-loss iya ngaphasi kwentengo yanamhlanje, ngombana intengo kufuze yehle bona iyifikelele. Yibeke ngaphezulu begodu sele iliqiniso, ngalokho ithengisa ngasikhatjhana oyibeka ngaso, begodu lokho kukuthengisa kunokobana kube lilifu lokuvikela.

20.title: Kunini Ukuthenga Nokuthengisa
20.content:
Iphoso elikhulu khulu abatjali abatjha abalenzako? Ukuthenga lokha woke umuntu athabile nokuthengisa lokha woke umuntu asabile. Lokho kuphambene ngambala nalokho okusebenzako. 🤦

📱 Lokha igroup chat yakho igcwala 'THENGA LELI SHEYA NJESI!!!!' → ihayiphu kanengi sele ifakiwe entengweni. Usele emva.

😱 Lokha woke umuntu athengisa ngokwesaba → ngezinye iinkhathi lokho kuthuba lokuthenga ngesaphulelo. Ngezinye iinkhathi intengo iragela phambili yehla omunye umnyaka. Akakho umuntu okhalisa ibhelu phasi khulu.

Isifihlo? Ba nehlelo NGAPHAMBI kokutjala:

• Ngizakuthengisa ngayiphi intengo nayehla? (i-stop-loss)

Namathela ehlelweni lakho. Ungavumeli imizwa yakho ithathe iqhinga lakho! 💪

quiz.explanation: Lokha isheya sele likhulunywa kiwo woke amagroup chat, ukutjhuguluka okukhulu sele kwenzekile, begodu abantu abafika kade bathenga kilabo abathatha inzuzo yabo. Qala inkampani ngokwakho. Isiqhema esinomsindo akufani nesiqhema esiliqiniso.

21.title: Yini Inani Lemakethe?
21.content:
Inani lemakethe (market cap) likutjela bona inkampani ikhulu kangangani ngambala, ngemali (imali: {cPlural}).

📐 Ifomula: Intengo Yesheya × Inani Loke Lamasheya = Inani Lemakethe

Isibonelo: Nangabe i-{retail} inamasheya ayi-1 billion begodu isheya ngalinye libiza u-{c}50, inani lemakethe ngu-{c}50 BILLION. Leyo 'yintengo' yenkampani yoke.

🔵 Large cap: amagama amakhulu khulu nasimeme khulu, afana ne-{tech} ne-{bank}. Ingozi ephasi, kanengi ukukhula okukancani.
🟡 Mid cap: iinkampani ezilinganiselweko. Ingozi elinganiselweko.
🔴 Small cap: iinkampani ezincani. Zingakhula msinyana NAMKHA ziwe kumbi.

⚠️ Imikhawulo akusiyeyephasi loke. E-US, 'large cap' kanengi kutjho ngaphezu kwe-$10 billion, kodwana imakethe ngayinye ibeka amazinga wayo, ngalokho i-large cap e-{name} ayinabo ubukhulu obufanako ne-large cap e-US. Funda inani lamambala, ingasi ilebula kwaphela 🧐

quiz.q: Inkampani A inamasheya ayi-5 million ngo-{c}200 ngalinye. Amasheya weNkampani B abiza u-{c}10. Dosela kumamiliyoni wamasheya iNkampani B ewatlhogako bona ibe nevalu efanako ne-A.
quiz.explanation: Inani lemakethe yintengo yesheya iphindwe ngenani lamasheya. Inkampani A inevalu eyi-5 million iphindwe ngo-{c}200, okungu-{c}1,000 million. Inkampani B kufuze ifikelele inani elifanako loke ngo-{c}10 isheya, ngalokho itlhoga amasheya ayi-100 million, aphindwe kamatjhumi amabili. Intengo ephasi yesheya ayikutjeli litho ngobukhulu benkampani.

22.title: Isilinganiso se-P/E Sihlathululwa
22.content:
Isilinganiso se-P/E (Intengo-ukuya-eNzuzweni) sikutjela bona ubhadala bungakanani ngeyunithi ngayinye yenzuzo yenkampani (imali: {cName}).

📐 Ifomula: Intengo Yesheya ÷ Inzuzo Ngesheya = Isilinganiso se-P/E

Cabanga ngakho njengentengo ngesiqetjhana sephizza 🍕

Nangabe iphizza A ibiza u-{c}80 ngeenqetjhana ezi-8 = {c}10/isiqetjhana
Nangabe iphizza B ibiza u-{c}100 ngeenqetjhana ezi-5 = {c}20/isiqetjhana

Iphizza A itjipe khudlwana ngesiqetjhana. Umbono ofanako namasheya:
• I-P/E ephasi (ngaphasi kwe-10) = kungenzeka intengo ehle, NAMKHA imakethe ilindele bona inzuzo yayo IZAKWEHLA. I-P/E ephasi mbuzo, ingasi ipendulo.
• I-P/E ephezulu (ngaphezu kwe-25) = imakethe ilindele ukukhula okukhulu esikhathini esizako. Inkampani bese kufuze ikuletha ngambala.

Hlala umadanisa i-P/E nezINYE iinkampani embonini efanako. Ungamadanisi i-P/E yebhanga ne-P/E yenkampani yethekhnoloji!

quiz.q: Inkampani A ine-P/E ka-8. Inkampani B (embonini efanako) ine-P/E ka-30. Lokhu kuveza ini?
quiz.explanation: I-P/E ephasi itjho ukubhadala okuncani ngeyunithi ngayinye yenzuzo, okungatjho intengo ehle namkha inkampani esemrarweni. Isilinganiso siphakamisa umbuzo; asiwuphenduli.
options: Inkampani A itjipe khudlwana ngeyunithi yenzuzo, kodwana fumana bona KUBAYINI ngaphambi kokuthenga
Inkampani B ihlala ikutjala okungcono kwazo zombili
Isilinganiso se-P/E asisizi nakancani ezinqunweni zokutjala imali

23.title: Ukufunda Imiphumela Yeenkampani
23.content:
Qobe ngemva kweenyanga ezimbalwa, iinkampani zikhupha 'ireporthi' yazo (qobe kota kezinye iimakethe, kabili ngomnyaka kezinye) begodu lokho kutjhugulula iintengo zamasheya KHULU. Nakhu okufuze ukuqale:

📊 IMALI ENGENAKO (revenue): Yoke imali engenako evela ekuthengiseni. Njengokobana isitolo esincani sithole bungakanani soke.
💰 INZUZO EPHELELEKO (net profit): Okuseleko NGEMVA kokubhadala zoke izindleko. Imali yamambala esele ekupheleni kwelanga.
📈 I-EPS (Inzuzo Ngesheya): Inzuzo ehlukaniswe ngenani lamasheya. Isheya ngalinye lizuze bungakanani.

Iimbonakaliso ezihle: Imali engenako IYAKHUPHUKA + Inzuzo IYAKHUPHUKA + I-EPS iyakhula = 🟢 intengo kanengi iyakhuphuka
Iimbonakaliso ezimbi: Imali engenako IYEHLA + Inzuzo iyawa = 🔴 intengo kanengi iyehla

Nasi isibambiso: okutjhugulula intengo ngambala mphumela uqhathaniswa nalokho imakethe ebeyi-KULINDELE. Iinombolo ezihle khulu ezifike ngaphasi kwalokho obekulindelwe zisengehlisa isheya.

Inkampani ingaba nemali enengi engenako kodwana ingabi nanzuzo (izindleko eziphezulu). Hlala uhlola KOKUBILI!

quiz.q: I-{bank} ibika bona imali engenako ikhuphuke nge-15% kodwana inzuzo yehle nge-20% ngebanga lezindleko eziphezulu. Lesi sitshwayo esihle namkha esimbi?
quiz.explanation: Imali engenako ngilokho okungenileko, inzuzo ngilokho okuseleko. Izindleko lapha zikhuphuka msinyana ukudlula ukuthengisa, ngalokho inkampani yenza ibhizinisi elinengi begodu igcina okuncani kilo. Leso sisiyeleliso samambala, kodwana akusikuwa, begodu into elandelako okufuze uyifumane kukobana kubayini izindleko zikhuphukile.
options: Kuyatshwenya, ngombana bathengisa okunengi kodwana bagcina okuncani
Kuqinile, ngombana imali engenako ekhuphukako ngiyo eqakathekileko ngambala
Kumbi khulu, ngombana inzuzo eyehlako itjho bona inkampani iyahluleka

25.title: Yini I-ETF?
25.content:
Ukukhetha iingoma ngayinye bekuyindlela kwaphela yokwakha i-playlist. Bese kwafika i-Spotify yakunikela ama-playlist asele enziwe, iqoqo elisheshako ngaphandle kokuzikhandla. 🎵

Ama-ETF (Exchange-Traded Funds) ayi-Spotify yokutjala imali. Esikhundleni sokukhetha amasheya linye ngelinye, uthenga I-ETF YINYE ebamba ibhasikidi loke lawo.

Ama-ETF amanengi alandela I-INDEX: uhlu lweenkampani olutjhicilelweko oluhlanganiswe ngokwencwadi yemithetho. {etfDesc} I-ETF ivele ithenge okusehlwini, ngeengcenye ezifanako, begodu iyazivuselela lokha uhlu lutjhuguluka.

Ngalokho i-ETF yinye ye-{etf} ikunikela isiqetjhana esincani se-{etfBasket} (amagama afana ne-{top5}) ngokuthenga kunye.

⚠️ I-index AKUSIZO ngokuzenzakalelako 'iinkampani ezikulu khulu'. Ezinye iinhlu zihlela ngobukhulu, ezinye ngokobana isheya lirhwebelwana kangangani, begodu ezinye zikhethwa yikomiti. Ama-index amabili emakethe yamasheya efanako angaba neenkampani ezihluke ngokupheleleko. Hlala ufunda bona uhlu luyini ngambala ngaphambi kobana ululuthenge.

Ama-ETF kanengi atjipe khudlwana, alula begodu ahlukaniswe khulu kunokukhetha amasheya ngokwakho. Abaphathi bamafundi abasebenzi abanengi abakghoni ukuwahlula! 🤯

quiz.q: Uthenga iyunithi yinye ye-ETF ye-{etf}, elandela i-{etfBasket}. Unani njesi?
quiz.explanation: I-index luhlu olutjhicilelweko, begodu i-ETF ye-index ithenga koke okukulo ngeengcenye ezifanako. Iyunithi yinye ngalokho ibamba isiqetjhana segama ngalinye elisehlwini, yikho ukuthenga kunye sele kuhlukanisiwe. Akusilo igama elikhulu kwaphela, begodu akusimali elinde iinqophiso zakho.
options: Isheya linye enkampanini ekulu khulu kulolo hlu
Isiqetjhana esincani sayo yoke inkampani ekulolo hlu
Imali isikhwama esiyibambileko bekube umtjela okufuze sikuthenge

26.title: Ama-ETF we-{ex}

quiz.explanation: Igala hlangana kwemibadelo emibili yi-1.8% ngomnyaka, begodu i-1.8% ka-20,000 NT ngu-360 NT. Lokho kuyaphuma kungakhathaliseki bona ifundi iyakhuphuka namkha iyehla, begodu kuyaphuma godu qobe mnyaka. Akakho ongakutjela bona ifundi izakubuyisa bungakanani, kodwana imbadelo itjhicilelwa ngaphambi kokuthenga, kanengi ibizwa ngokobana yi-TER namkha i-expense ratio.

27.title: Ama-ETF Womhlaba Newekhaya

Yabelana ngayo, ngombana abasekeli abaqinisekisiweko bayayitlhoga bona bahlole i-akhawundu yakho
Yabelana ngamagama wokuthoma ayisithandathu kwaphela, okuphephile ngokwaneleko
Babawe bona bakuthumelele i-imeyili evela ekhelini elisemthethweni kuqala, bese wabelana ngayo

38.title: Isilwanyana Sekhripto
38.content:
Sikhathi sendaba woke umuntu ayikhulumako begodu akakho oyitjela kuhle.

Ekuthomeni kwaka-2017, i-Bitcoin yinye beyibiza pheze u-$1,000. NgoDisemba 2024 yadlula u-$100,000 kokuthoma. Ukuthenga kuka-$1,000, okubanjwe indlela yoke, kwaba pheze ngu-$100,000. Lokho yi-100x. 🤯

Njesi isiqephu ihayiphu esitjhiyako: bona uthole leyo 100x bekufuze ukghodlhelele ukuwa okubili okumbi khulu, okukhulu pheze yi-84% nenye pheze yi-77%, ubone imali yakho ihlatjhwa IMINYAKA ngaphandle kokuthengisa. Pheze akakho owakghonako. Abantu abanengi bathenga phezulu, besaba ekuweni, bathengisa phasi.

Begodu nge-Bitcoin ngayinye kuneenkulungwana zeenkhoyini ezifileko ezaya ku-zero. Ukukhetha ophumelelako ngaphambili kubonakala kulula kwaphela nawuqala emuva. Lokho kubizwa ngokobana yi-survivorship bias, begodu kuyinkohliso ebiza khulu ekhripto.

Isifundo samambala somtjhini wesikhathi: eenkhoyinini ezasindako, ukubekezela kwahlula ukukhetha isikhathi. Kodwana uthola kwaphela bona ngiziphi iinkhoyini ezisindako NGEMVA KWALOKHO, yikho ukwahlukanisa ukutjala kuhlula ukukhetha kweqhawe, nokobana kubayini AKAKHO owazi ikusasa. Ngitjho nesilwanyana. 🐉
38.bossVictory: Imojuli yekhripto ihluliwe. Njesi wazi okunengi kunabantu abadala abanengi. 🐉

quiz.q: Iinkulungwana zeenkhoyini zathonyelwa kanye ne-Bitcoin, begodu ezinengi njesi zinevalu epheze ibe lilize. Kubayini "khetha i-Bitcoin elandelako nje" kubonakala kulula kangaka nawuqala emuva?
quiz.explanation: Abasindako kwaphela abasakhulunywa ngabo, ngalokho ukukhetha abaphumelelako kubonakala kulula khulu nawuqala emuva kunalokho bekunjalo ngaleso sikhathi. Iinkulungwana ezahlulekako azitjhiyanga mkhondo endabeni.
options: Ngombana abaphumelelako kwaphela ngibo abantu abasakhuluma ngabo, begodu labo abafako banyamalala endabeni
Ngombana iinkhoyini ezihle khulu ziyabonakala kusukela ekuthomeni kinanyana ngubani ofunda ngokwaneleko ngazo
Ngombana iinkhoyini ezinengi ziba zihle ekugcineni kinanyana ngubani obekezela ngokwaneleko bona azibambe iminyaka
Ngombana iingcwethi zayibikezela kuhle i-Bitcoin emuva ngo-2010 begodu zibikezele boke abaphumelelako kusukela lapho

39.title: Yini NGAMBALA I-Blockchain?
39.content:
Susa ihayiphu begodu i-blockchain ilula ngendlela emangazako: incwadi yamarekhodi eyabelwana ngayo amakhomphyutha ayiinkulungwana agcina amakhophi afanako wayo.

Nange umuntu athumela ikhripto, lokho kurhwebelana kungena 'ebhlokeni' kanye namakhulu amanye. Ibhloko ivalwa ngezibalo begodu ibotjhelelwe kubhloko yangaphambili. Yikho: ibhloko. Iketane. ⛓️

Kubayini kunanyana ngubani okhathalako? Ngebanga lalokho ekwenza kukghoneke:

✅ Akakho ongatjhugulula umlando ngokuthula. Ukutjhugulula ibhloko endala bekungatjho ukwenza godu yoke ibhloko engemva kwayo kumakhomphyutha ayiinkulungwana ngesikhathi sinye.
✅ Ayikho inkampani namkha urhulumende munye oyiphethe. Inethiwekhi yamakhomphyutha iyiphatha ndawonye.
✅ Nanyana ngubani angahlola irekhodi. Koke ukurhwebelana kwe-Bitcoin okwakhe kwenziwa kuyabonakala emphakathini.

Leyo yithekhnoloji etjha ngambala. Kodwana AKUSIYIMALI yomlingo. Irekhodi elipheleleko lekhoyini engasiyilutho lisese yikhoyini engasiyilutho. Ukuba kwamambala kwethekhnoloji akwenzi yoke ikhoyini eyakhiwe phezu kwayo ibe nevalu. 🧠

quiz.q: Kubayini kubudisi kangaka ukutjhugulula ngefihlo ukurhwebelana okudala ku-blockchain?
quiz.explanation: Ibhloko ngayinye ivalelwe kuleyo engaphambi kwayo, ngalokho ukutlola godu endala kutjho ukutlola godu yoke ibhloko engemva kwayo, kumakhomphyutha ayiinkulungwana, msinyana ukudlula inethiwekhi yengeza ezitjha. Yikho lokho okwenza irekhodi libe ngelingapheliko ngambala.
options: Yoke ibhloko elandelako bekufuze yenziwe godu nayo
Ukutjhugulula ngakunye kufuze kuvunywe ngurhulumende
Yoke irekhodi elidala ukudlula inyanga liyasulwa
Umenzi wekhoyini ngayinye ugcina ikiya yokutjhugulula eyifihlo

40.title: I-Bitcoin Nakho Koke Okhunye
40.content:
'Ikhripto' akusinto yinye. Umahluko uqakatheke khulu kunokufana:

₿ I-BITCOIN: yokuthoma. Ubunengi bayo bukhawulelwe kuma-21 million weenkhoyini unomphela, kutlolwe ekhowudini, begodu ubunengi beenkhoyini ezitjha buhlukaniswa kabili pheze qobe ngemva kweminyaka emine. (Kuzwakala kujayelekile? I-halving ye-NOOB iboleka ncamancama umbono lo.) Ukukhangisa kwayo koke kukunqaba kanye nokuphepha.

⟠ I-ETHEREUM: incani 'njengegolide yedijithali', inengi 'njengekhomphyutha yephasi'. Isebenzisa ama-smart contract, okumaphrogremu azenzakalelako. Ama-app wekhripto amanengi akhiwe phezu kwayo namkha phezu kwabancintisani bayo.

🪙 KOKE OKHUNYE: iinkulungwana zama-'altcoin'. Ambalwa arhulula imiraro yamambala. Amanengi makhophi, amalingo, namkha ukuhlwitha imali. Isibalo esibuhlungu: ubunengi beenkhoyini ezakhe zenziwa sele zifile namkha azisiyilutho.

Isifundo: 'ikhripto iyakhuphuka' ikutjela pheze ilitho ngekhoyini ETHILEKO. Ngayinye ibheja layo, namathuba wayo. 🎲

quiz.q: Ubunengi obuphezulu be-Bitcoin bungakanani, begodu bungatjhugululwa lula kangangani?
quiz.explanation: Umkhawulo wama-21 million uyingcenye yemithetho yoke ikhomphyutha esenethiwekhini eyisebenzisako. Ukuwukhuphula bekungatjho pheze woke avumelane bona enze lokho asele anakho kube nevalu ephasi, yikho umkhawulo uthathwa njengongatjhuguluki.
options: Ama-100 million, begodu abamayini bayavota ngakho qobe mnyaka
Ama-21 million, begodu ukuwukhuphula pheze akukghoneki
I-1 billion, begodu umenzi angayilungisa
Akukho umkhawulo nakancani, ngalokho iinkhoyini ezitjha zigadangiswa unomphela

41.title: Ama-stablecoin
41.desc: Ikhripto elinga ukuhlala ime kwenye indawo
41.content:
I-stablecoin yikhripto eyakhelwe bona ihlale ibiza inani elibekiweko, kanengi elingana ncamashi nedola le-US elilodwa. Abarhwebi bayisebenzisa njengendawo yokupaka: thengisa iinkhoyini zakho ezitjhuguluka khulu uzijamise ku-stablecoin, bese imali yakho ihlala ime njengombana uqunta igadango elilandelako.

Zihlala njani ku-$1? Umklamo omkhulu ugcina amadola wamambala neempahla njengesilondolozi, ngalokho ikhoyini ngayinye isekelwa yinto ethileko. Uthemba nanyana ngubani obambe ilondolozi leyo.

Nansi indaba yakho yesiyeleliso: ama-stablecoin ANGAPHUKA. Sekwenzeke isibili. Ngo-2022 i-stablecoin ekulu 'ye-algorithm', ebeyisebenzisa iimbalo ezihlakaniphileko esikhundleni selondolozi lamambala, yawa isuka ku-$1 yaya eduze no-zero emalangeni ambalwa, yatjhabalalisa amatjhumi weengidigidi zamadola. 'Ukuzinza' mgomo womklamo, ingasi isiqinisekiso.

Umthetho olula: lokha indlela egcina into 'iphephile' ihlakaniphe khulu, kufanele uyiqale ngelihlo elibukhali khulu. 🔍

quiz.q: Ngimuphi umsebenzi omkhulu we-stablecoin?
quiz.explanation: Umsebenzi we-stablecoin kuhlala ime. Yindawo yokupaka hlangana kokurhweba, ingasi into okulindeleke bona ikhule.
options: Ukubamba inani elibekiweko, kanengi u-$1, bona abarhwebi babe nendawo yokupaka ezinzileko
Ukukhula msinyana kune-Bitcoin ngokulandela yoke imakethe yekhripto
Ukubhadala inzalo ngokuzenzakalela kinanyana ngubani oyibambe esikhwameni
Ukufihla ukurhweba kiwo woke umuntu ngokudida irekhodi yomphakathi

42.title: Ikhripto, Umthelo NoMthetho
42.content:
I-inthanethi izele abantu abakholelwa bona ikhripto yimali engabonakaliko engenamithetho. Kanengi bafumana iqiniso ngendlela ebuhlungu. 😬

Iqiniso emanarheni amanengi, kufaka hlangana neSewula Afrika:

🧾 INZUZO KANENGI IYATHELELWA. Thengisa ikhripto ngaphezu kwalokho obhadele ngakho, begodu iziphathimandla zomthelo kanengi zifuna isabelo sazo, njengamasheya.

🪪 AMA-EXCHANGE AYAKWAZI BONA UNGUBANI. Iinkundla ezisemthethweni zifuna ukuqinisekiswa kwe-ID (kubizwa ngokobana yi-KYC, Know Your Customer). Ukurhweba koke kuphasi kutlolwa unomphela ku-blockchain ngokwayo, lokho OKUPHAMBENE nokungaziwa.

⚖️ ABALAWULI BAKHONA. ESewula Afrika, iimpahla zekhripto zithathwa ngokusemthethweni njengemikhiqizo yeemali, okutjho bona iinkundla ezizithengisako kufanele zilandele imithetho yeensiza zeemali.

Akukho kilokhu okuyibanga lokutjhaya ivalo. KODWANA libanga lokungalaleli nanyana ngubani othi 'imithetho ayisebenzi kukhripto'. Iyasebenza, begodu ukuzenza ngathi akunjalo kungenisa abantu abadala emrarhweni omkhulu isibili.

quiz.q: Umzala wakho uthi inzuzo yekhripto ayibonakali eziphathimandleni zomthelo ngombana ikhripto ayaziwa. Kumbi ngani ngalokho?
quiz.explanation: Iinkundla ezisemthethweni ziqinisekisa bona ungubani ngaphambi kobana urhwebe, begodu ukurhweba koke ku-blockchain kusobala begodu kuhlala unomphela, lokho okuphambene nokungaziwa. Inzuzo kanengi iyathelelwa, ngalokho hlola imithetho lapho uhlala khona.
options: Ama-exchange ahlola i-ID, begodu amarekhodi asobala
Akukho, ikhripto ayaziwa isibili
Ikhripto ithelelwa e-America kwaphela, akukho kwenye indawo
Umthelo uthoma nawukhupha isigidi

43.title: Ukutjhuguluka Nemithetho Yokuphila
43.content:
Ilanga elimbi emakethe yamasheya ngu-3%. Ilanga elimbi ekhriptweni ngu-20%. Ngitjho ne-Bitcoin, 'umuntu omdala' wekhripto, seyalahlekelwa ngaphezu kwe-80% wenani layo kanengi kunakanye bese yabuyela esimweni. Iinkhoyini ezincani kanengi zilahlekelwa ngu-95% begodu azisabuyi.

Kubayini kurhabha kangaka? Ikhripto irhwetjwa 24/7 ngaphandle kwamabhlokisi wokuyimisa, inengi layo lithengwa ngemali eboleka ethengiswa ngekani nakuwa iintengo, begodu iintengo zilawulwa ziindaba nemizwa ukudlula imibiko yenzuzo.

Nansi imithetho yokuphila, ephindwa ngiwo woke umrhwebi onelwazi:

1️⃣ Ungafaki imali ongekhe ukghone ukulahlekelwa ngiyo yoke.
2️⃣ Lungisa ubukhulu bokurhweba bona ingozi yinye ingakuqedi.
3️⃣ Qunta indlela yokuphuma NGAPHAMBI kobana ungene, nanyana usathobile.
4️⃣ I-FOMO mmuzwa obiza khulu eemalini.

Ziqeqeshe zoke ezine ku-NoobTrader lapho ukulahlekelwa kungasi kwamambala. Imikhuba yiyo umklomelo wamambala. 🏆

quiz.q: Ngimuphi kilezi ongumthetho wamambala wokuphila emakethe etjhuguluka khulu?
quiz.explanation: Ukungabeki engozini imali ongekhe ukghone ukulahlekelwa ngiyo ngiwo umthetho owodwa okugcina emdlalweni. Ukuphinda kabili ngemva kokulahlekelwa yindlela ama-akhawunti aphela ngayo.
options: Phinda kabili ubukhulu bokurhweba kwakho ngemva kokulahlekelwa koke bona ukubuyise
Ungatjali imali ongekhe ukghone ukulahlekelwa ngiyo yoke
Ukutjhuguluka kuthinta iinkhoyini ezincani kwaphela, ngalokho iinkhoyini ezikulu ziphephile
Thenga njalo lokha woke umuntu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana athenga

44.title: Imijikelezo Ye-Hype Ne-FOMO
44.content:
Ikhripto ikhamba ngemijikelezo ye-hype, begodu nawusuyibone iphethini angekhe usayikhohlwa:

📈 Isigaba 1: kwenzeka into yamambala. Abakholwa bokuthoma bathenga bathule.
🚀 Isigaba 2: iintengo ziyakhuphuka. Abezindaba bayalemuka. Ifidi yakho izala abaphumeleleko.
🎪 Isigaba 3: ukuhlanya. Abatjhayeli bamatekisi banikela ngamathiphu wekhoyini. Abantu bayaboleka bona bathenge. 'Kwanje kuhlukile.'
💥 Isigaba 4: ukuwa. Abafike sele, abathenge phezulu khulu, balahlekelwa khulu.
🕳️ Isigaba 5: ukuthula. Iinthunyelwa zabaphumeleleko ziyanyamalala. Akekho okhuluma ngokulahlekelwa kwakhe.

Ukuqhakaza kwe-NFT ngo-2021 kulandela isikripthi lesi ncamashi: iinto zedijithali ezibuthwako bezithengiswa ngeengidi phezulu, begodu ngemva kweminyaka embalwa inengi lazo belingasabizi litho.

Iqhinga elinesihluku lakho koke ukuhlanya: lenza isikhathi ESIMBI KHULU sokuthenga sizwakale njengesikhathi SOKURHABHA KHULU sokuthenga. Lokha kuzwakala kuphephe khulu ukungena, ngombana woke umuntu sele angenile, inzuzo elula kanengi isiphelile. 🎯

quiz.q: Emjikelezweni we-hype ojayelekileko, umuntu ojayelekileko uzwa nini isifiso esinamandla khulu sokuthenga?
quiz.explanation: Isifiso siqine khulu lokha indaba iphakame khulu, begodu indaba iphakama khulu ngemva kobana intengo sele ikhuphukile. Ukuthi woke umuntu ungenile kwenza kuzwakale kuphephile, begodu kwenza bona kungabi nomuntu oseleko ozakuthenga.
options: Ekuthomeni, nanyana kungekho muntu okhuluma ngakho
Phakathi nokuwa, lokha iintengo ziphasi
Eduze kwesiqongo, lokha woke umuntu sele angenile
Akulandeli iphethini, isifiso sizenzakalela nje

45.title: Ukufunda Ikhendlela
45.content: Ikhendlela ngalinye lixoxa indatjana encani ngeenomboro ezine kwaphela: lapho intengo ivule khona, lapho ikhuphukele khona phezulu khulu, lapho yehlele khona phasi khulu, nalapho ivale khona. Umzimba oqinileko usuka ekuvuleni uye ekuvaleni, begodu umbala ukutjela bona ngimuphi ophumeleleko: oluhlaza litjho bona ukuvala kuphele ngaphezu kokuvula, obomvu litjho bona abathengisi bayihudulele ngaphasi. Leli liqhinga loke. Funda ukufunda ikhendlela linye kuhle, begodu woke amatjhadi ephasini azakusuka ekubeni lidonga lomsindo abe yindaba yeenthombe. 🟢

quiz.q: Ikhendlela leli liluhlaza. Likutjelani ngesikhathi sokurhweba leso?
options: Intengo ivale iphasi kunalapho ivule khona
Abantu abanengi bathengile kunalabo abathengisileko, kuqinisekisiwe
Intengo ivale iphezulu kunalapho ivule khona
Intengo ayikhange yehle nakancani ngesikhathi leso

46.title: Iintambo Zixoxa Iindaba
46.content: Umzimba utjengisa lapho isikhathi sivule khona nalapho sivale khona, kodwana iintambo (wicks) zitjengisa ikhambo loke: yoke intengo ipi le eyafika kiyo isibili. Intambo ende itjho bona kube nepi elikhulu ngaphandle kokuvula nokuvala, begodu ihlangothi elitjhiye intambo ngemva lahlulwa kilelo ipi. Intambo ende ngaphasi? Abathengisi baqhubela phasi ngamandla bebuyiselwa emva. Intambo ende phezulu? Abathengi bafika phezulu kodwana bala. Umzimba siyihlokwana, iintambo ziinhlebo. 📏

quiz.q: Imigca etjhingileko (iintambo) ngaphezulu nangaphasi komzimba itjengisani isibili?
options: Iintengo eziphezulu khulu neziphasi khulu ezarhwetjwako ngesikhathi leso
Ukuvula nokuvala kwamazolo
Iintengo ncamashi lapho ukurhweba okunengi kwenzeke khona
Isibikezelo sebanga lakusasa

47.title: I-Doji
47.content: Ngezinye izikhathi ikhendlela livula livale cishe ngentengo efanako ncamashi, litjhiye umzimba omncani khulu oneentambo ngeenhlangothi zombili. Leyo yi-doji, begodu itjho bona ukudonsana kwentambo kuphele ngokulingana: abathengi nabathengisi badonsa ngamandla isikhathi soke begodu akukho hlangothi oluphumeleleko. Ngokwalo kuyikukakazisa amahlombe nje. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okunamandla kungatjengisa bona umkhuba uyadinwa, ngombana ihlangothi ebeliphumelela ngokuzumako alikghonanga ukutjhukumisa intengo. Ilitjhwayo okufanele ulitlole, ingasi isiqinisekiso. 🤝

quiz.q: Ikhendlela elikhanyako livule lavala cishe ngentengo efanako ncamashi. Libizwa ngokobana kuyini, begodu litjengisani?
options: Yi-marubozu, ilitjhwayo lokuqiniseka okupheleleko kunanyana ngiliphi ihlangothi
Sisando, ilitjhwayo lokobana abathengi babuyisele amandla
Yi-gap, ilitjhwayo lokobana ukurhweba kwema ebusuku
Yi-doji, ilitjhwayo lokungaqunti hlangana kwabathengi nabathengisi

48.title: Isando
48.content: Cabanga ngesikhathi esinesihluku: abathengisi baqhoboza intengo phasi, bese abathengi bayihudulela emva yoke indlela ngaphambi kokuvala. Lokho okusala etjhadini sisando (hammer): umzimba omncani eduze kwaphezulu onentambo ende ngaphasi engaba kabili ubukhulu bawo okungenani. Ngemva kokwehla, isando sitjho bona abathengisi balinge ihlabo labo elihle khulu kodwana alikhange lithinte. Lokho kanengi kutjengisa ukujika okungenzeka. Okungenzeka, ingasi okuthenjisiweko, ngalokho kuthathe njengelitjhwayo lokuqala, ingasi njengomyalo wokuthenga. 🔨

quiz.q: Ngemva kokwehla, ikhendlela elikhanyako litjengise intambo ende ngaphasi nomzimba omncani eduze kwaphezulu. Kuyini?
options: Yinkwekwezi ewako (shooting star), ilitjhwayo lokobana abathengisi bathathe izintambo
Sisando, ilitjhwayo lokobana abathengi balwe kabuhlungu
Yi-doji, ukulingana okupheleleko
Ubufakazi bokobana umkhuba wokwehla uphelile

49.title: Inkwekwezi Ewako
49.content: Isithombe sesibuko sesando. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okunamandla, abathengi balinga ukufikelela esiqongweni esitjha kanye godu, bayaliwa ngamandla, begodu intengo ivala ibuyele phasi eduze kwalapho ivule khona. Itjhadi litjengisa umzimba omncani ngaphasi kwekhendlela onentambo ende ngaphezulu: inkwekwezi ewako (shooting star). Kutjho bona abathengisi ekugcineni bafike phezulu ngamandla anele bona baphumelele isikhathi leso. Ngemva kokukhuphuka okukhulu, ukwaliwa lokho kanengi kuqakathekile. Kanengi, ingasi njalo. 🌠

quiz.q: Ngemva kokukhuphuka okunamandla, ikhendlela elikhanyako leqele phezulu bese lavala eduze kwephasi lalo, latjhiya intambo ende ngaphezulu. Kuyini?
options: Yinkwekwezi ewako, ilitjhwayo lokobana abathengisi bafike phezulu
Sisando, ilitjhwayo lokobana abathengi babuyele ekulawuleni
Yi-marubozu eluhlaza, amandla wokuthenga ahlwengileko
Isiqinisekiso sokobana intengo izakuwa kusasa

50.title: I-Marubozu
50.content: I-marubozu mzimba munye oqinileko ongenantambo nanyana yinye: intengo yavula yakhamba ngendlela yinye isikhathi soke ingakhange iqale emva. Akukho pi, akukho kudlhadlhaleka, ukuqiniseka okupheleleko kwehlangothi linye. I-marubozu eluhlaza imemeza ukuzethemba kwabathengi, ebomvu imemeza okuphambeneko. Ayivamili, begodu kungebanga lokho abarhwebi bavuseleleka nayivela. 💪

quiz.q: Ikhendlela elikhanyako mzimba munye oqinileko ongenantambo nanyana yinye. Isimo leso sikutjelani?
options: Akekho owarhweba ngesikhathi leso, ngalokho yahlala ilingana
Imakethe yavala msinyana ngelanga leso yayiqeda ingakapheleli
Ihlangothi linye belilawula kusukela ekuvuleni ukufika ekuvaleni, ukuqiniseka okupheleleko
Abathengi nabathengisi bebalingana ncamashi kusukela ekuthomeni ukufika ekupheleni

51.title: Ukugwinya Kwabathengi (Bullish Engulfing)
51.content: Amakhendlela amabili, umlayezo munye. Kuthoma ikhendlela elincani elibomvu, okujayelekileko emkhubeni wokwehla. Bese kulandela umzimba omkhulu oluhlaza oligwinya ngokupheleleko: esikhathini sinye, abathengi basula koke abathengisi abakuzuze ilanga elidlulileko, nangaphezulu. Nakuvela ngemva komkhuba wokwehla, ukugwinya kwabathengi (bullish engulfing) kungelinye lamatjhwayo wokujika aqalwa khulu kinanyana ngiliphi itjhadi, ngombana kutjengisa ukulingana kwamandla kutjhentjha ekhendleleni elilodwa. Ilitjhwayo, ingasi isivumelwano. 🐂

quiz.q: Umzimba omkhulu oluhlaza ugwinya ngokupheleleko umzimba obomvu ongaphambi kwawo. Iphethini le yamakhendlela amabili kuyini?
options: Ukugwinya kwabathengisi (bearish engulfing), abathengisi bathathe izintambo
Ukugwinya kwabathengi (bullish engulfing), abathengi bahlule abathengisi
Iphasi elikabili (double bottom)
Ama-doji amabili alandelanako

52.title: Ukugwinya Kwabathengisi (Bearish Engulfing)
52.content: Isithombe sesibuko sohlobo lwabathengi. Esiqongweni sokukhuphuka, umzimba omkhulu obomvu ugwinya woke umzimba oluhlaza ongaphambi kwawo: abathengisi basula ukuthenga kwelanga elidlulileko ekhendleleni elilodwa, khona lapho ukukhuphuka bekuse kudlulele begodu abathengi bamva bebatjhaya ivalo. Lokho kanengi kwenza nabathengi abaseleko batjhaye ivalo. Nawukubona ngemva kokukhuphuka okude, kuhloniphe. 🐻

quiz.q: Esiqongweni sokukhuphuka, umzimba omkhulu obomvu ugwinya woke umzimba oluhlaza ongaphambi kwawo. Ibizwa ngokobana kuyini ipheya le?
options: Ukugwinya kwabathengi, ukukhuphuka kuyaragela phambili
Isando esilandelwa yi-doji
Ukuqhekeza (breakout) ngaphezu kwe-resistance
Ukugwinya kwabathengisi, abathengisi bahlule abathengi

53.title: Ukubona Umkhuba Wokukhuphuka
53.content: Umkhuba wokukhuphuka (uptrend) utlhoga iingcenye zombili: iinqongo eziphakamako NAMAPHASI aphakamako. Isiqongo ngasinye sidlula esidlulileko, begodu ukwehla ngakunye kuma phezulu kunangaphambilini, ngombana abathengi bangena msinyana qobe kanye. Isimo leso sesitebhisi yimakethe ikutjela bona isidingo siyalawula. Isiqongo esiphakamako sinye ngokwaso asifakazi litho. Iphethini yipheya, iphindaphindeka. 📈

quiz.q: Isiqongo ngasinye sidlula esidlulileko, begodu ukwehla ngakunye kuma phezulu kunangaphambilini. Itjhadi leli litjengisani?
options: Umkhuba wokukhuphuka, iinqongo eziphakamako namaphasi aphakamako
Umkhuba wokwehla, iinqongo eziphasi namaphasi aphasi
Ibanga (range), intengo ibambeke hlangana kwephasi nesilingi
Iqongo elikabili (double top) elisakheka

54.title: Ukubona Umkhuba Wokwehla
54.content: Phendulela isitebhisi phasi phezulu. Iinqongo eziphasi zitjho bona abathengisi bahlasela msinyana kukho koke ukuqhasha, amaphasi aphasi atjho bona abathengi babuyela emva khulu kukho koke ukwehla. Nasisabambile isakhiwo leso, abathengisi baphethe umbukiso, begodu ukulwa nakho yindlela abarhwebi abatjha abanikela ngayo ngemali kwababekezelako. Umkhuba (trend) awusisitha sakho, kodwana ukuzenza ngathi awukho isitha isibili. 📉

quiz.q: Koke ukuqhasha kuphelela phasi kunokudlulileko, begodu koke ukwehla kungena phasi khulu. Uqalene nani?
options: Umkhuba wokukhuphuka othatha umoya nje
Ibanga eliya ngeenhlangothi
Umkhuba wokwehla, iinqongo eziphasi namaphasi aphasi
Iphethini yokugwinya kwabathengi esakheka

55.title: Imakethe Eya Ngeenhlangothi
55.content: Ngezinye izikhathi akukho hlangothi oluphumelelako, ngalokho intengo iqhasha nje hlangana kwephasi elifanako nesilingi esifanako iimveke. Lelo libanga (range), begodu iimakethe zichitha isikhathi esinengi khulu sokuphila kwazo zenza lokhu ncamashi. Ayikaphuki begodu ayiqedi amandla, yimakethe ethatha umoya. Abarhwebi ababekezelako bafunda ukuthanda ukulinda, ngombana nalibamba isikhathi eside ibanga, ukuphunyuka kwekugcineni kanengi kuba nehlonipho elikhulu. 🏓

quiz.q: Iimveke intengo beyiqhasha hlangana kwephasi elifanako nesilingi esifanako. Lokhu kubizwa ngokobana kuyini?
options: Umkhuba wokukhuphuka, ihlala ithinta isilingi
Ibanga, imakethe iya ngeenhlangothi
Ihloko namahlombe (head and shoulders)
Ukuqhekeza (breakout) okusenzeka

56.title: I-Support
56.content: Lokha intengo ihlala yehlela ezingeni elifanako begodu iqhasha qobe kanye, abarhwebi babiza izinga leso ngokobana yi-support: iphasi lapho abathengi bahlala baqunta bona intengo ilihlelo. Nalibamba kanengi, abantu abanengi bayaliqala, okungelinye lamabanga wokobana lihlale libambile. Kodwana khumbula bona iphasi lidwetjwa babantu, ingasi umthetho. I-support ingaphuka begodu iyaphuka, begodu nayiphukako, isiqubuthu sokuqhasha siba sisiqubuthu sokutjhaya ivalo. 🧱

quiz.q: Intengo yehlele ezingeni elifiphalisiweko kathathu, begodu yaqhasha qobe kanye. Abarhwebi balibiza ngokobana kuyini izinga leso?
options: Yi-resistance, isilingi lapho abathengisi bagcwala khona
Mgca womkhuba, amazinga kufanele abe ngatjhingilizi
Yi-stop-loss ebekwe yi-exchange
Yi-support, iphasi lapho abathengi bahlala bangena khona

57.title: I-Resistance
57.content: I-resistance sisilingi: izinga lapho koke ukukhuphuka kuhlala kuma khona ngombana abathengisi bathabile ukuthatha imali yabo lapho. Qala itjhadi lithula ihloko yalo entengweni efanako kathathu begodu uzabe uqala i-resistance isebenza ngesikhathi samambala. Nanti ilitjhuguluko okufanele ulikhumbule: nangabe intengo yake yaqhekeza ngokuqiniseka kwamambala, isilingi sakade kanengi sithoma ukusebenza njengephasi elitjha. 🪟

quiz.q: Ukukhuphuka okuthathu okuhlukahlukeneko kume ezingeni elifiphalisiweko. Izinga leso libizwa ngokobana kuyini?
options: Yi-resistance, isilingi lapho abathengisi bahlala bakhankasela emva
Yi-support, iphasi elingaphasi kwentengo
Lizinga ledividendi, elibekwa kanye ngomnyaka
Kukhuphuka kwevolumu, okungatjho litho ngentengo

58.title: Imigca Yemikhuba
58.content: Hlanganisa amaphasi akhuphukako etjhadini begodu uzabe udwebe umgca womkhuba (trendline). Amaphuzu amabili nanyana ngimaphi enza umgca, kodwana ukuthinta kwesithathu kulapho uthoma khona ukufakazela bona uqakathekile, ngombana kutjengisa bona abathengi bahlala bavikela izinga elifanako elikhuphukako. Koke ukuthinta okuhlonitjhiweko okungeziweko bubufakazi obunengi. Kuhlala kububufakazi, ingasi isithembiso: umgca womkhuba litjhwayo lepensela, ingasi isivikelo samandla. ✏️

quiz.q: Umgca lo okhuphukako uthintwe kathathu ngokuhlukileko. Kubayini abarhwebi bakhathalela bona umgca womkhuba uthintwe kangaki?
options: Abakhathali, ngombana amaphuzu amabili nanyana ngimaphi enza umgca womkhuba ube mthetho
Ukuthinta kathathu kutjho bona ukuqhasha kwesine kuqinisekisiwe okulandelako
Ukuthinta okunengi kwenza umgca uqakatheke khulu, abathengi bahlala bawuvikela
Imigca yemikhuba ibalwa ematjhadini welanga kwaphela, ingasi amafitjhani

59.title: Iinkhanyelo
59.content: Ikhanyelo (channel) mkhuba onemikhuba emihle. Intengo iyakhuphuka iqhasha hlangana kwemigca emibili elinganako: iphasi lamaphasi akhuphukako nesilingi seenqongo ezikhuphukako, kukhuphuka ndawonye njengeenhlangothi zomzila. Abarhwebi baqala imiphetho yombili bona kuqhashwa, begodu baqala khulu ngelanga intengo ephuma emzileni, ngombana ukuqhekeza okuhlwengileko ukuphuma ekhanyelweni kanengi kulapho kuthoma khona ukutjhukuma okukhulu okulandelako. 🛣️

quiz.q: Intengo iyakhuphuka iqhasha hlangana kwemigca emibili elinganako. Iphethini le kuyini?
options: Unxantathu, lapho imigca emibili kufanele ihlangane
Ikhanyelo elikhuphukako, umkhuba wokukhuphuka onomzila obonakalako
Iqongo elikabili (double top)
Ibanga elilinganako elingayi ndawo nakancani

60.title: Iqongo Elikabili
60.content: Intengo ithula isilingi esifanako kabili, yehluleka kabili, begodu idweba i-M ekulu etjhadini. Yehlele ngaphasi kokwehla okuphakathi (umgca wentamo, neckline) begodu iqongo elikabili (double top) seliphelele: ilitjhwayo elidumileko lokujikela phasi. Isithombe salo sesibuko, i-W, liphasi elikabili (double bottom), begodu likhomba ngakwelinye ihlangothi. Kanengi litjengisa isiqongo, akukafaneli. Akukho etjhadini okufanele. Ⓜ️

quiz.q: Intengo ithule isilingi esifanako kabili, yehluleka kabili, bese yehlela ngaphasi kokwehla okuphakathi. Isimo lesi kuyini?
options: Iphasi elikabili, ilitjhwayo lokukhuphuka
Ikhanyelo elikhuphukako
Isando
Iqongo elikabili, ilitjhwayo lokujikela phasi

61.title: Lokha Iiphethini Zehluleka
61.content: Lesi sisifundo esiqakatheke khulu kule-modyuli. Iphethini yeencwadi yakheka, woke umuntu wayibona, bese imakethe yenza okuphambeneko. Yoke iphethini oyifundileko iyehluleka ngezinye izikhathi, begodu lokho akusi litjhadi likuqamba amanga, litjhadi likunikela ilwazi: ihlangothi obulisekele lisandula ukulahlekelwa. Qunta indlela yokuphuma ngaphambi kobana ungene, begodu lokha iphethini yehluleka, zwisisa ilitjhwayo uphume. Iiphethini mathuba, akusi iinthembiso. 🚪

quiz.q: Iphasi elikabili leencwadi lakheka ephasini elifiphalisiweko... bese intengo yawa yalidlula ngqo. Sifundo bani seqiniso?
options: Iiphethini mathuba, akusi iinthembiso, begodu iphethini ehlulekileko yilitjhwayo lakho lokuphuma
Amaphasi amabili wamambala azange ehluleke, ngalokho lelo obuliqalile kufanele bekungelamanga
Thenga okunengi ngentengo ephasi, ngombana iphethini izakwenzeka ekugcineni
Amatjhadi ayayeka ukusebenza ngokupheleleko nayikhe iphethini yehluleka kuwe ngalokho

62.title: Ihloko Namahlombe
62.content: Iinqongo ezintathu: eside phakathi (ihloko), ephasi ngehlangothi ngalinye (amahlombe), nomgca ngaphasi kwamaphasi amabili obizwa ngokobana mgca wentamo (neckline). Yakheka lokha abathengi bakghona ukuqhubela kokugcina phezulu khulu bese bangakghoni ngitjho nokukulinganisa ngelinga elilandelako. Isimo ngokwaso siyisiyeleliso kwaphela. Ingcenye abarhwebi abayilindako isibili kuqhekeza okuqinileko ngaphasi komgca wentamo, ngombana ngilapho iphethini iyeka ukuba mdwebo bese iba sisiqunto. 👤

quiz.q: Iinqongo ezintathu: eside phakathi, ephasi ngehlangothi ngalinye, nephasi elihlanganisa ukwehla okubili. Isimo lesi esidumileko kuyini?
options: Iphasi elikathathu, amaphasi amathathu alinganako ngaphambi kokuqhubela phezulu
Ihloko namahlombe, ukuphela okungenzeka komkhuba wokukhuphuka
Unxantathu okhuphukako
Iinsando ezintathu ezilandelanako, ngasinye salo saliwa iintengo eziphasi

63.title: Ukuminyezwa Konxantathu
63.content: Lokha ukujinga kuhlala kuncipha, amaphasi aphakamako aminyezela phezulu ngeenqongo eziphasi, imakethe izisonga njengesipringi. Lowo nguxantathu (triangle): iinhlangothi zombili ziphelelwa yindawo, isiqunto siyakatelelwa. Ukuminyezwa kanengi kuphela ngokuqhuma, begodu nanti iqhinga: indlela yokuqhuma ayaziwa kusesengaphambili. Linda ukuqhekeza esikhundleni sokuqagela. Imakethe izakukutjela, begodu ayibhadalisi litho ngelwazi elo. 🌀

quiz.q: Ukujinga kuhlala kuncipha, kuminyezela intengo esisongweni esiqine khulu, kufikela ekugcineni iqhume. Isisongo sasiyini?
options: Ikhanyelo, imigca emibili elinganako engakhe ihlangane nakancani
Iqongo elikabili (double top)
Unxantathu, ukuhlanganiswa okuvame ukuphela ngokuqhekeza
Ubufakazi bokobana intengo bekufanele iqhekeze iye phezulu ukusuka lapha

64.title: Ivolumu: Umtjhini Wamanga
64.content: Ivolumu (volume) linani lamasheya atjhentjhe izandla, begodu ngumtjhini wokuhlola amanga wamatjhadi. Ukuqhekeza ngevolumu encani khulu kuhlebeza okukhohlisa abantu: ukurhweba okumbalwa kwaqhubela intengo endaweni engekhe ihlale kiyo. Ukuqhekeza ngevolumu ekulu siqubuthu sivota isibili ngemali. Ukutjhukuma kwentengo okufanako, ihlonipho elihluke ngokupheleleko. Ngaphambi kobana ukholwe nanyana ngikuphi ukutjhukuma okukhulu, hlola bona ngubani ofikele kikho. 🔊

quiz.q: Amalinga amabili wokuphunyuka esilingini esifanako: lokuthoma ngevolumu encani khulu lehlulekile, lesibili leza nevolumu ekulu khulu labamba. Ivolumu yenzani lapha?
options: Ayenzi litho, ivolumu ayikhe iqakatheke ekutjhukumeni kwentengo
Iqhubela intengo phezulu, ngombana ivolumu ephezulu ikhuphula iintengo
Ibikezela isiqongo ncamashi sokutjhukuma ngaphambi kobana kwenzeke

65.title: Umboni Wemikhuba

Thola u-8 ku-10 begodu i-modyuli ngeyakho. Uthola amalinga ama-3 ngelanga, ngalokho kghabisa, funda amakhendlela, begodu khumbula isifundo esiqakatheke khulu kunazo zoke: ngezinye izikhathi ipendulo yeqiniso kukobana ayikho iphethini nakancani. 🕯️

66.title: Akukho Into Oyiphetheko Lapha
66.content:
Koke osele ukufundile bekunento engemva kwakho. Thenga isheya le-{retail} begodu uba ngumnikazi wesiqephu senkampani: isiqephu seenrhweba, isiqephu senzuzo, ivowudi emhlanganweni, nedividendi nayibhadalwako.

I-derivative ayisinjalo.

I-CFD (contract for difference) sivumelwano hlangana kwakho nomhlinzeki sokutjhentjhiselana ngomehluko wentengo hlangana kwalokha uvula nalokha uvala. Lowo mkhiqizo woke. Nange i-{retail} ikhuphuka begodu bewubheja bona izakukhuphuka, bakubhadala umehluko. Nange yehla, wena ubabhadala. Akekho othenga isheya. Akekho othengisa isheya. Awekho amasheya akhona ndawo ekurhwebeni lokhu.

I-future sivumelwano sokuthenga namkha sokuthengisa into ngentengo ebekiweko ngelanga elibekiweko. Ezamambala zivalwa ngemiphongolo yamambala yamafutha namkha amathani wemealie, kodwana cishe akekho oyibamba isikhathi eside kangako, ngalokho empilweni yamambala ama-future amanengi nawo kubheja enomborweni enelanga lokuphela.

Kubayini lokhu kuqakatheke ukudlula indlela okuzwakala ngayo:

• Awekho amadividendi. Awekho ama-Money Babies. Into eyakha ngokuthula inengi lenzuzo esifundweni 15 ayikho lapha nakancani.
• Ayikho ivowudi, akukho ubunikazi, akukho okubambekako. Akukho khetho lokuthi 'yibambe nje iminyaka elitjhumi', ngombana akukho okubambekako.
• Akukho ukukhula okuphindaphindekako (compounding). I-app le yoke ichitha izifundo ezima-65 ikufundisa bona isikhathi sisehlangothini lakho. Kilekamelo, isikhathi sikubiza imali. Uzabona ncamashi bona kungangani esifundweni 72.

Koke osele ukwazi kusaqakathekile. Kodwana akusiyo into oyenzako. 📄

Akekho othenga isheya, akekho othengisa elinye, begodu awekho ndawo esivumelwaneni. Kungebanga lokho kungekho idividendi, ivowudi nanyana into ongayibamba iminyaka elitjhumi.
