67.content:
I-leverage izwakala njengento yobuchwepheshe. Akusinjalo. Kukuboleka.

Akhe uthi ufuna amasheya we-{c}1,000 kodwana une-{c}200 kwaphela. Umngane uthi uzakufaka i-{c}800 eseleko. Ulawula amasheya we-{c}1,000 nge-{c}200 yemali yakho. Leyo yi-leverage. Lowo mbono woke.

Njesi izinto ezintathu umngane lowo azenzako. Uzitlhoga zoke ezintathu, ngaphandle kwalokho uthengiselwe inganekwane.

1️⃣ INZUZO NGEYAKHO ISIBILI. Amasheya akhuphuka ngo-10%. I-{c}1,000 yakho njesi yi-{c}1,100. Leyo yinzuzo ye-{c}100 begodu uyigcina yoke, ngombana umngane wakho ukweletwa i-{c}800 kwaphela, kungasi ngitjho ne-{cName} yinye ngaphezulu. Ku-{c}200 yakho, i-{c}100 yinzuzo ye-50%. Ukutjhukuma kwe-10% kukwenzele i-50%. Le yingcenye woke umuntu ayithumelako.

2️⃣ ISIKWELETU ASINCIPHI NAWUNGASI NELIQINISO. Le yingcenye engathunyelwa muntu, begodu siyisifundo soke. Amasheya ehla ngo-10% kunalokho. I-{c}1,000 yakho njesi yi-{c}900. Usakweleta umngane wakho i-{c}800 yoke. Ingasi i-{c}720. I-{c}800 yoke. Ngalokho koke ukwehla kwe-{c}100 kuphuma esabelweni SAKHO, begodu i-{c}200 yakho njesi yi-{c}100. Ukutjhukuma kwe-10% kukubize i-50%.

Funda lezo ezimbili godu. Umngane ofanako, i-10% efanako. Imali yakho itjhukuma ngebelo eliphindwe kahlanu ngeendlela zombili, ngombana isikweletu asikhe sithathe isabelo sobuhlungu.

3️⃣ UMNGANE UBHADALISA IRENDE, QOBE LANGA, KUKHO KOKE. Ingasi ku-{c}800 yakhe. Ku-{c}1,000 yoke oyilawulako. Qobe busuku uyibambile, nanyana intengo ikhuphukile, yehlile, namkha ayikhange iye ndawo.

Begodu kunento yesine efihlakele ngaphakathi kwesithathu. Nange i-{c}200 yakho iphela, umngane wakho akakufowuneli bona nikhulume ngakho. Uyathengisa. Msinyana, ngokuzenzakalela, nanyana kungiyiphi intengo ekhona, ngombana yi-{c}800 yakhe esengozini begodu akalindi umbono wakho. Lokho kunebizo, begodu uzakuhlangana nalo ngemva kwezifundo ezintathu: ukuvalwa ngekani (liquidation).

Ngalokho: inzuzo ekulu, ukulahlekelwa okukhulu, irende qobe busuku, nomunye umuntu onomunwe wakhe enkinobhweni yokuthengisa. I-leverage ayisiyo imali yamahhala enengozana encani. Sisikweletu esinazo zoke ezine lezo, begodu iinkhangiso zikutjengisa yokuthoma kwaphela. 🧠

quiz.q: Umngane ufaka i-800 NT, wena ufaka i-200 NT, begodu ndawonye nilawula amasheya we-1,000 NT. Amasheya ehla ngo-10%. Hudula uye kilokho i-200 NT yakho ebiza kona njesi.
quiz.explanation: Isikweletu asinciphi nawungasi neliqiniso. Amasheya njesi abiza i-900 NT begodu umngane wakho usakweletwa i-800 NT yoke, ngalokho i-100 NT ngiyo eseleko yakho. Ukwehla kwe-10% emasheyeni kuthathe isiquntu semali yakho, ngombana isikweletu asithathi nakancani ebuhlungwini. Kusebenza ngendlela efanako nakukhuphukako, begodu leyo yingcenye iinkhangiso ezikutjengisa yona.

68.title: I-Margin Sibambiso, Ingasi Kuthenga
68.content:
Nawuthenga isheya nge-{c}100, i-{c}100 leyo iphumile emalini yakho begodu isheya lihlezi ku-akhawunti yakho. Ukutjhentjhiselana okulula.

I-margin ayisebenzi ngalokho. Nawuvula isikhundla se-leverage ubeka isibambiso, begodu isibambiso leso asisiyo imbadelo yanto. Sisibambiso sokuvikela ukulahlekelwa kwakho. Sihlala lapho, sikhiyiwe, begodu isikhundla siyasidla njengombana intengo iya ngokuphambene nawe.

Akhe uthi izinga lesibambiso ngu-25%. Ubeka i-250 NT begodu ulawula i-1,000 NT. Qala i-akhawunti yakho:

• Intengo ayitjhukumi: i-250 yakho isese yi-250. Ngaphandle kobana imali yokuqashisa sele ithomile, ngalokho ngokuthula sele incani.
• Intengo yehle ngo-5%: isikhundla silahlekelwe yi-50 NT. Isibambiso sakho empilweni yamambala sesiyi-200. Imali yakho ekhululekileko ayikhange itjhukume. I-akhawunti yakho incani.
• Intengo yehle ngo-20%: isikhundla silahlekelwe yi-200 NT. Isibambiso sakho sehlele ku-50. Awukhange wenze litho. Awukhange uthengise litho. Ubukele.

Amagama amathathu ahlala kizo zoke iinkrini kilekamelo:

🔒 I-MARGIN ESETJENZISIWEKO: soke isibambiso osibekileko njesi.
💰 I-EQUITY YE-AKHAWUNTI: imali yakho ekhululekileko, kuhlanganise ne-margin oyibekileko, kuhlanganise namkha kukhutjwe inzuzo nokulahlekelwa kwazo zoke iinkhundla ezivulekileko, kukhutjwe imali yokuqashisa ebhadaliswe bekube njesi. Lokho i-akhawunti yakho ebiza kona isibili nange koke bekungavalwa njesi.
📊 IZINGA LE-MARGIN: i-equity ehlukaniswe nge-margin esetjenzisiweko. Ngaphezu kwe-100% unomqamelo. Ngaphasi kwe-100% imakethe isiqede umqamelo begodu isithome esibambisweni.

Nomthetho owodwa omangalisa woke umuntu: i-margin ilinganiswa ku-akhawunti yoke, ingasi esikhundleni ngasinye. Isikhundla esilahlekelako sidla isibambiso esisekela esiphumelelako. Kungebanga lokho 'okhunye ukurhweba kwami kuhle' kungasi kuzivikela. 🔒

quiz.q: Izinga lesibambiso ngu-25%, ngalokho i-250 NT yemali yakho ilawula i-1,000 NT. Intengo yehla ngo-8% nanyana wena ungenzi litho. Hudula uye kilokho ukwehla lokho okubize kona.
quiz.explanation: Isibambiso asisiyo imbadelo yanto, sisiqinisekiso, begodu ukulahlekelwa kubalwa ku-1,000 NT yoke oyilawulako. I-8% ye-1,000 NT yi-80 NT. Awukhange uthengise litho begodu imali yakho ekhululekileko ayikhange itjhukume, kodwana i-80 NT ye-250 NT yesibambiso sakho sele idliwe begodu i-akhawunti yakho incani nge-80 NT. Bala i-8% esibambisweni kunalokho begodu uthola i-20 NT, okulitjhwayo elenza i-leverage ibonakale ingasi yingozi.

69.title: Ibizo Le-Margin (Margin Call)
69.content:
Ibizo le-margin (margin call) mzuzu lapho izinga le-margin yakho lehlela ngaphasi kwe-100%. Ngamagama alula: umqamelo wenzuzo yakho uphelile begodu imakethe sele ithome ukudla isibambiso ngokwaso.

Nakhu ezwakala ngakho isibili, ngombana uhlobo lweencwadi luyayitjhiya ingcenye eqakathekileko.

Alikhe lifike ngelanga elihle. Lifika lokha isikhundla sele simbi, lokha sele uzitjele kabili bona sizakubuya, begodu lokha ungakghoni khulu ukwenza isiqunto esinokuthula. Akusiso isaziso esinehlonipho. Kuyifuno: faka imali engeziweko, namkha uvale iinkhundla, namkha umhlinzeki akwenzele khona.

Unamagadango amathathu begodu mabili kwaphela angewakho.

1️⃣ VALA okuthileko. Lokhu kukhulula i-margin msinyana begodu kanengi kuyipendulo efaneleko. Kutjho nokuvuma bona ubungasi neliqiniso, okulibanga lamambala abantu bangakwenzi.
2️⃣ ENGEZA imali. Lokhu akulungisi litho. Kukuthengela isikhala sokungabi neliqiniso isikhathi eside, esikhundleni osele usikhethe kumbi, ngemali obungahlelanga ukuyibeka engozini. Ukwengeza imali ebizweni le-margin yindlela ukurhweba okumbi okuba yinyanga embi ngayo.
3️⃣ UNGENZI LITHO. Bese igadango lesithathu lenzeka ngaphandle kwakho, begodu linebizo.

Abalawuli bakuthatha lokhu ngokuqakatheka khulu kangangobana batlola inomboro emthethweni. Iinkampani e-Europe, e-UK nase-Australia kufanele zivale ngokuzenzakalela iinkhundla zekhasimende elijayelekileko lokha i-margin yalo yehlela ku-50% walokho obekutlhogeka. Ingasi 'kungaba kuhle'. Kufanele. Batlola umthetho lowo ngombana lokha abantu bekutjhiywa bona baqunte ngokwabo, bakhetha ikhetho 3 balahlekelwa ngaphezu kwalokho ebebanakho. ⚠️

quiz.q: Izinga le-margin yakho lehlele ku-80% begodu useebizweni le-margin. Ngiyiphi ipendulo enciphisa isibili ingozi yokuvalwa ngekani kunokobana iyilibazise nje?
quiz.explanation: Ukuvala kubuyisa isibambiso msinyana, ngalokho izinga le-margin liyeqa khonokho. Ukwengeza imali kuthenga isikhala sokungabi neliqiniso isikhathi eside ekurhwebeni osele ukukhethe kumbi. Ukulinda yindlela ukuvalwa ngekani okwenzeka ngayo. Begodu isikhundla sesibili ngakwelinye ihlangothi sitlhoga isibambiso saso, ngalokho sisebenzisa i-margin enengi, ingasi encani.
options: Ukufaka imali engeziweko ku-akhawunti
Ukulinda bona izinga le-margin likhuphuke godu
Ukuvala esinye seenkhundla ezivulekileko
Ukuvula isikhundla sesibili ngakwelinye ihlangothi

70.title: Ukuvalwa Ngekani, Nentengo Okufanele Uyazi Kuqala
70.desc: Intengo ncamashi lapho i-akhawunti yakho ifika ku-zero
70.content:
Ukuvalwa ngekani (liquidation) kukobana umhlinzeki avale iinkhundla zakho ngombana isibambiso sakho sese siphela. Kuzenzakalela. Kwenzeka msinyana. Akekho obuza umbono wakho, akekho ohlola nange bewuzakuba neliqiniso, begodu akukho kudlulisela phambili.

Inomboro eqakatheke khulu kule-modyuli yoke yi-INTENGO YOKUVALWA NGEKANI: intengo yamambala, ngemali yamambala ({cPlural}), lapho lokho kwenzeka khona.

Ingasi iphesenti. Intengo. Ngombana 'ungalahlekelwa sisibambiso sakho' ngumutjho ongavuma ngehloko bese uyakhohlwa, kanti 'i-{tech} ku-{c}87.40 begodu i-akhawunti yakho ayinalitho' liqiniso ongalihlola etjhadini ngaphambi kobana ucindezele litho.

Yoke iskrini kilekamelo iyitjengisa ngaphambi kobana uqinisekise, idwetjwe esikalini sentengo esifanako netjhadi bona ubone bona ikhatjhana kangangani isibili. Izinto ezimbili ozazibona msinyana, begodu zombili ziyisifundo:

📏 Isibambiso esikhulu siqhubela intengo yokuvalwa ngekani khatjhana. Imali yakho enengi ngaphakathi itjho bona intengo inendlela ende yokwehla ngaphambi kobana imali yakho iphele.
⚡ Isibambiso esincani siyihudulela eduze nentengo yanamhlanjesi. Esibambisweni se-10%, ukuvalwa ngekani kukhatjhana ngokutjhukuma kwe-10% cishe, begodu ukutjhukuma kwe-10% yiveke ejayelekileko.

Bese kuba nelinga leqiniso. Intengo yokuvalwa ngekani kulapho injini ihlose ukukuvala khona, ingasi lapho uqinisekiswa ukuphuma khona. Nange iindaba ezimbi zifika ebusuku begodu imakethe ivuleka godu ngaphasi khulu kwezinga leso, uvalwa nanyana kungiyiphi intengo imakethe ezayibhadala isibili. Leyo yi-gap, begodu isifundo 78 sikhuluma ngayo.

Yazi intengo yakho yokuvalwa ngekani ngaphambi kobana uvule. Nawungekhe ukghone ukuyitjho ngephimbo, awukuzwisisi ukurhweba ozakwenza. 💀

quiz.q: Ubeka i-200 NT njengesibambiso bona ulawule i-1,000 NT yempahla ebiza i-100 NT. Hudula intengo iye phasi lapho isibambiso sakho siphela khona.
quiz.explanation: Ulawula iinyunithi ezili-10, ngalokho yoke i-1 NT intengo eyehla ngayo ikubiza i-10 NT. Isibambiso sakho se-200 NT siphela ku-80 NT, okukwehla kwe-20% kwaphela.

71.title: Indlela Yokubuyela Imqansa Khulu
71.desc: Kubayini ukulahlekelwa kubudisi ukukulungisa kunalokho okubonakala kunjalo
71.content:
Ukulahlekelwa nenzuzo kuzwakala njengezinto eziphambeneko. Akusinjalo, begodu iimbalo azikho eduze.

Ulahlekelwe yi-10%? Utlhoga u-+11% bona ubuyele. Kuyacaphula, kulungile.
Ulahlekelwe yi-50%? Utlhoga u-+100%. Kufanele UPHINDE KABILI bona ulinganise nje.
Ulahlekelwe yi-75%? Utlhoga u-+300%.
Ulahlekelwe yi-90%? Utlhoga u-+900%.

Ibanga lilula nawusulibonile: inzuzo ibalwa enqwabeni encani oseleyo. U-100 wehlela ku-50, begodu bona akhuphuke asuke ku-50 abuyele ku-100 inqwaba encani leyo kufanele iphindwe kabili.

Njesi engeza i-leverage, begodu ulemuke lokho ekwenza isibili. Ayenzi nje bona inzuzo yakho isheje. Ikwehlisela phasi etafuleni leyo ngentambama yinye. Ukwehla kwe-12% esheyeni, okuyiveke embi kodwana ejayelekileko ngokupheleleko, kulihlabo le-48% ku-akhawunti yakho esibambisweni se-25%. Njesi utlhoga u-+92% bona ubuyele lapho uthome khona, ngenca yeveke engakhange ifike eendabeni.

Kungebanga lokho iingcwethi zikhuluma ngokuvikela imali eyisisekelo ngaphambi kobana zikhulume ngenye into, begodu kubayini 'ngizayibuyisa' kungumutjho obiza khulu ekurhwebeni. Ukuyibuyisa kubudisi ngokwezibalo kunokuyilahlekelwa, qobe kanye. ⛰️

quiz.q: I-akhawunti yakho yehle ngo-75%. Hudula uye enzuzweni oyitlhogako ukusuka lapha bona ubuyele nje lapho uthome khona.
quiz.explanation: I-100 NT yehlele ku-25 NT. Bona ifike ku-100 godu, i-25 leyo kufanele iphindwe kane, okuyinzuzo ye-300%. Ukukhuphuka kulinganiswa enqwabeni encani oseleyo, kungebanga lokho kumqansa khulu kunokwehla.

72.title: Irende Yemali Ebolekiweko
72.content:
Uboleke i-exposure. Ngalokho uyayibhadalela. Qobe busuku.

Imali yokuqashisa (ezinye iindawo ziyibiza ngokobana yi-swap, namkha imbadelo yobusuku) ibhadaliswa qobe langa, begodu nansi ingcenye ebamba woke umuntu: ibhadaliswa esikhundleni SOKE, ingasi engcenyeni oyibolekileko. Beka i-500 NT bona ulawule i-2,000 NT begodu ubhadala irende ku-2,000.

Ibalwa njani: izinga lenzalo elijayelekileko, kuhlanganise nenzuzo yomhlinzeki, kuhlukaniswe ngo-365, kuphindwe ngesikhundla sakho soke. Ubona iingcenye zombili eskrinini ku-app le, ngombana imbadelo ongekhe uyihlukanise yimbadelo ongekhe uyahlulele. Ku-7.3% cishe ngomnyaka, lokho kuba yi-0.02% cishe yesikhundla sakho qobe busuku.

Kuzwakala njengokungasi litho. Njesi qala kudla ukurhweba okuphumelelako. 🧾

UKURHWEBA OKWENZA KUHLE KODWANA USALAHLEKELWA

Uvula isikhundla se-2,000 NT ku-{retail} ngesibambiso se-500 NT. Ulindele bona izakukhuphuka, begodu uba neliqiniso: eenyangeni ezimbalwa ezilandelako i-{retail} ikhuphuka KANCANI ngo-2%.

• Inzuzo yakho: i-2% ye-2,000 = 40 NT. Esibambisweni se-500 NT lokho ngu-+8%. Kuhle.
• Irende yakho: i-0.02% ye-2,000 = 0.40 NT, qobe busuku.

Ubusuku 50: sele ubhadele i-20 NT. Uphezulu nge-20 NT soke. Usaphumelela.
Ubusuku 100: sele ubhadele i-40 NT. Inzuzo yakho ye-40 NT njesi ibiza zero ncamashi. Ubone kuhle begodu akukho okuzuzileko.
Ubusuku 180: sele ubhadele i-72 NT. Inzuzo yakho isese yi-40 NT. Uphasi nge-32 NT, okuyi-6.4% ekhutjwako esibambisweni sakho, ekurhwebeni lapho ufunde khona imakethe kuhle iinyanga ezisithandathu.

Funda lokho godu. Intengo yenze lokho obukutjhilo. Kodwana usalahlekelwe.

Nangu umutjho okufanele uwuthathe kilesi sifundo: esikhundleni se-leverage, ukuba neliqiniso kunelanga lokuphelelwa. Kilesi sibonelo kubusuku obu-100 ukusuka njesi, begodu ungabala okwakho ngaphambi kobana uvule. Hlukanisa inzuzo oyithembileko ngerende yobusuku. Lelo linani lobusuku umbono wakho obiza bona.

Okuphambeneko nakho kufanele kulemukwe. I-app le yoke ifundisa ngokukhula okuphindaphindekako, lapho isikhathi ngokuthula sikwenzela imali nawulele. Lo mtjhini ofanako, osebenza ngemva, okhombe kuwe. ⏳

quiz.q: Ubambe isikhundla se-leverage se-2,000 NT esikubiza i-0.40 NT ngobusuku ngemali yokuqashisa. Intengo ikhuphuka ngokwanele bona ikunikele inzuzo ye-40 NT, bese ayisatjhukumi. Ngemva kobusuku obungaki inzuzo leyo idliwe ngokupheleleko?
options: Ayikhe idliwe, ngombana imali yokuqashisa ibhadaliswa engcenyeni ebolekiweko kwaphela
Cishe ubusuku obu-100, ngombana i-40 NT yenzuzo ihlukaniswe nge-0.40 NT ngobusuku ngu-100
Cishe ubusuku obu-20, ngombana imali yokuqashisa ibhadaliswa esibambisweni sakho se-500 NT
Imali yokuqashisa ibhadaliswa kwaphela lokha isikhundla sivalwa ngokulahlekelwa

73.title: Ama-Future: Iwatjhi Nokutjhentjha (Roll)
73.content:
Ama-future nama-CFD bazala. Kokubili kune-leverage, kokubili kusebenzisa i-margin, kokubili kungakuvala ngekani. Izinto ezimbili zenza ama-future ahluke, begodu yesibili ngiyo ethabisako.

⏰ 1. KUNELANGA KUYO. Soke isivumelwano se-future siyaphelelwa. Amafutha kaMatjhi, imealie kaJuni, i-index kaSeptemba. Lokha ilanga lifika isivumelwano siyavalwa begodu asisekho. 'Yibambe ulinde bona ibuye' akukho kumenyu, ngombana isivumelwano angekhe sibe khona. I-CFD ayikhe iphelelwe, okuzwakala kungcono bekube ukhumbula bona ibhadalisa irende unomphela.

🔄 2. IZINDLEKO ZAKHIWE NGAPHAKATHI KWENTENGO, AZIBHADALISWA QOBE BUSUKU. Le yingcenye abantu abayitjhiyako. I-future kanengi ayikubhadalisi imali yokuqashisa yobusuku. Kunalokho, izindleko zokubamba into bekube lilanga leso sele zibhakwe ngaphakathi kwentengo yesivumelwano. Iivumelwano zamalanga wamva kanengi zibiza ngaphezu kweevumelwano zamalanga wangaphambili, begodu umehluko lowo zizindleko ezifanako zokubamba, zihlezi ngaphakathi kwenomboro.

Ngalokho kwenzekani lokha umrhwebi afuna ukugcina isikhundla ngemva kokuphelelwa? Bayatjhentjha (ROLL): bavala isivumelwano esiphelelwako, bavula esilandelako. Begodu nange esilandelako sibiza ngaphezulu, babhadala umehluko lowo. Qobe nabatjhentjhako. Leyo yirende yobusuku ye-CFD, ibuthelelwe ngeenqephu ezikulu, ezingavamili.

Isifinyezo seqiniso:

• I-CFD: alikho ilanga lokuphela, irende qobe busuku, itlolwe esitatimendeni sakho.
• I-future: ilanga lokuphela eliqinileko, izindleko zifihlwe ngaphakathi kwentengo begodu zibhadalwa qobe nawutjhentjhako, kulula ukuzitjhiya.

Akukho kizo ezimahhala. Enye yazo ikwethula ibhili ngehlonipho elingeziweko, begodu izindleko ongekhe uzibone ngizo ezingakumangaza khulu. ⏳

quiz.q: Umrhwebi ufuna ukubamba isikhundla se-future ngemva kwelanga laso lokuphelelwa, begodu isivumelwano esilandelako sirhwetjwa ngentengo ephezulu kunesiphelelwako. Kwenzekani lokha batjhentjhako (roll)?
quiz.explanation: Ukutjhentjha (rolling) kutjho ukuvala isivumelwano esizakuphelelwa nokuvula esilandelako. Nange esilandelako sibiza ngaphezulu, unikela ngomehluko lowo, begodu ukwenza godu qobe nawutjhentjhako. Zizindleko ezifanako zokubamba i-CFD ezikubhadalisa zona qobe busuku, zibuthelelwe ngeenqephu ezikulu begodu zifihlwe ngaphakathi kwentengo kunokobana zitlolwe esitatimendeni sakho.
options: Babhadala umehluko hlangana kwesivumelwano esiphelelwako nesilandelako
Babhadalwa umehluko hlangana kwamanani weevumelwano ezimbili
Akukho mali etjhentjha izandla, ngombana ukutjhentjha kurhweba kunye kwaphela
Isikhundla siba yi-CFD begodu siragela phambili singenalo ilanga lokuphelelwa

74.title: Ukuthengisa nge-Short: Ukulahlekelwa Okungenaphasi
74.content:
Koke ku-app le bekube njesi bekuyi-long: uyathenga, ufuna bona intengo ikhuphuke. Ama-derivative akuvumela bona uthengise nge-short, okutjho ukubheja bona intengo izakwehla. Uvula i-short, intengo iyehla, uyazuza.

Ukuthengisa nge-short kunesizo isibili begodu akusikumbi. Yindlela umlimi avikela ngayo intengo ngaphambi kokuvuna nendlela isikhwama sevikela ngayo iphothifoliyo. Ukukuzwisisa kukwenza ube ngcono ekufundeni iimakethe, ngombana kokuthoma ungabona iinhlangothi zombili zakho koke ukurhweba.

Kodwana kunengcenye yinye yezibalo ekuthengiseni nge-short engafani nanyana yini kwenye indawo, begodu kufanele uyitjhise engqondweni yakho.

📉 NAWUTHENGA, okumbi khulu kukobana intengo iye ku-zero. Ulahlekelwa yi-100% yalokho okufakileko. Kumbi, kodwana liphasi. Kunesiphelo phasi.
📈 NAWUTHENGISA NGE-SHORT, intengo ekuphambeneko itjho intengo ekhuphukako. Begodu awukho umthetho ndawo othi intengo ivunyelwe ukukhuphuka bekube kuphi. Isheya eliphindeka kathathu likubiza i-200% yesikhundla. Isheya elikhuphuka kalitjhumi likubiza i-900%.

Ukulahlekelwa kwe-long kunephasi. Ukulahlekelwa kwe-short akunalo. Ukungalingani lokho kusiyeleliso soke.

Iimakethe zamambala ziyakwenza lokhu. Ngezinye izikhathi isheya elithengiswe nge-short khulu liyaqhuma, ngombana woke umuntu onayo i-short ukatelelwa bona athenge bona avale, okuqhubela intengo phezulu khulu, okukatelela abanengi babo bona bathenge. Kubizwa ngokobana yi-short squeeze begodu sele kuqede iinkhwama.

Izinto ezimbili zikugcina uphila. Kokuthoma, i-short kulapho i-stop-loss iyeka ukuba yikhetho khona. Kwesibili, ukuvikelwa kwebhalansi ekgevu (negative balance protection): ku-akhawunti ejayelekileko elawulwa kuhle, nakule-app, i-akhawunti yakho angekhe yehlele ngaphasi kwe-zero. Ungalahlekelwa koke okufakileko. Angekhe ugcine ukweleta imali. Ukuvikelwa lokho kukhona ngombana, ngaphambi kwakho, abantu bebakweleta. 🕳️

quiz.q: Kubayini okumbi khulu esikhundleni se-short kuhlukile ngobunjalo kunokumbi khulu esikhundleni se-long?
quiz.explanation: Ukuthenga kunephasi. Okumbi khulu intengo engakwenza kufika ku-zero, ngalokho ulahlekelwa lokho okufakileko kwaphela. Ukuthengisa nge-short kuphambene, ngombana ukulahlekelwa kutjho intengo ekhuphukako, begodu akukho okutjho bona intengo ingakhuphuka bekube kuphi. Isheya eliphindeka kathathu libiza othengisa nge-short isikhundla siphindwe kabili. Kungebanga lokho i-stop iyeka ukuba yikhetho ku-short, nokobana kubayini i-app le ingekhe ikwehlisele ngaphasi kwe-zero.
options: Akuhlukanga, ngombana kokubili kukhawulelwe kilokho okufakileko
I-stop-loss ibeka iphasi elifanako ngaphasi kwe-short njenge-long
Ukwehla kuhamba kancani kunokukhuphuka, ngalokho i-short ilahlekelwa kancani
Intengo ingehlela ku-zero kwaphela, kodwana ingakhuphuka ngaphandle komkhawulo

75.title: Ukutjhuguluka Kuphindwe Nge-Leverage
75.desc: Kubayini ikhripto itlhoga isibambiso esikhulu khulu lapha
75.content:
Isiphindi esifanako eempahleni ezimbili ezihlukeneko akusikubheja okufanako. Lowo mbono woke kilesi sifundo, begodu kungebanga lokho isibambiso okufanele usibeke sitjhuguluka kuya ngokobana urhweba ngani.

Cabanga ngokobana ilanga elijayelekileko libukeka njani:
• I-index ekulu itjhukuma ngaphasi kwe-1% emalangeni amanengi.
• Isheya elilodwa lingatjhukuma ngo-2% namkha ngo-3%.
• Ikhripto kanengi itjhukuma ngo-5% namkha ngo-10%, begodu ilanga le-20% akusiyo ingozi, nguLesibili nje. 🎢

Njesi beka isibambiso esincani ngemva kwazo zoke lezo. Esibambisweni se-10%, ukutjhukuma kwe-10% kukuqeda. Ku-index, lokho kwenzeka kanye eminyakeni embalwa. Ekhriptweni cishe qobe nyanga. Isibambiso esifanako. Amathuba wokuphila ahluke ngokupheleleko.

Abalawuli bakubona lokhu bakutlola emithethweni. Lokha i-ESMA ikhawulela i-leverage ye-CFD e-Europe yoke ngoMatjhi 2018, ayikhange ikhethe inomboro yinye. Yazibeka ngamazinga: 30:1 kumapheya weemali amakhulu, 20:1 egolideni nakuma-index amakhulu, 10:1 kwezinye iimpahla, 5:1 emasheyeni munye ngamunye, begodu phasi khulu, 2:1 ekhriptweni. Okubili kokukodwa kutjho isibambiso se-50%. Ekhriptweni bafuna ISIQUNTU sesikhundla ngemali yamambala, izinga eliqine khulu ehlwini yoke.

I-app le yenza into efanako, ngebanga elifanako, begodu iyakutjho eskrinini kunokuthi ikufihle:

💱 I-Forex: isibambiso esincani khulu, ngombana amapheya amakhulu atjhukuma kancani khulu.
🥇 Igolide neempahla: esikhulu.
📊 Amasheya, ama-index nama-ETF: esikhulu godu.
🪙 Ikhripto: isibambiso esikhulu khulu kunazo zoke, ngombana ikhripto itjhukuma ngamandla khulu.

Ikhripto ayiliswanga lapha, begodu lokho kwenziwe ngehloso. Ungarhweba ngayo. Kodwana angekhe urhwebe ngayo ngesibambiso esincani, ngombana esibambisweni esincani ilanga elijayelekileko lekhripto belizakuqeda i-akhawunti yakho ngaphambi kobana uqede ukufunda ngakho. Isibambiso esikhulu akusi yi-app ezenza ngokungathandi ikhripto. Yi-app iqinisekisa bona ilanga elijayelekileko angekhe likubulale.

Kufanele ukwazi: umlawuli we-UK waya phambili kunezinga. Ngo-2021 walisa ama-derivative wekhripto emakhasimendeni ajayelekileko ngokupheleleko, alinganisa bona abathengi bazakonga cishe i-£53m. Ungahlangana ne-leverage yekhripto lapha, ngemali yokudlala nesibambiso esikhulu, namkha ungahlangana nayo uneminyaka elitjhumi nesificaminabunane ngemali yamambala ngaphandle kwesiyeleliso nakancani. Lokhu kulandelana okungcono. 🌡️

quiz.q: Ikhripto itlhoga isibambiso esikhulu khulu kinanyana ngiyiphi impahla kilekamelo. Ngiliphi ibanga lamambala?
quiz.explanation: I-index ekulu itjhukuma ngaphasi kwe-1% emalangeni amanengi. Ikhripto kanengi itjhukuma ngo-5% namkha ngo-10%, begodu ilanga le-20% akusiyo ingozi, nguLesibili nje. Esibambisweni esincani, ukutjhukuma kwe-10% kukuqeda, okwenzeka kanye eminyakeni embalwa ku-index begodu cishe qobe nyanga ekhriptweni. Umlawuli we-Europe wafuna isiquntu sesikhundla ngemali yamambala ekhriptweni, izinga eliqine khulu ehlwini yakhe yoke, ngebanga leli ncamashi.
options: Abangaphasi kweminyaka eli-18 baliselwe ikhripto, ngalokho isibambiso siyijeziso
Ayikho imali yokuqashisa ebhadaliswa ekhriptweni, ngalokho isibambiso siyayithatha indawo yayo
Itjhukuma ngamandla khulu, ngalokho ilanga elijayelekileko lingaqeda isibambiso esincani
I-app ibeka amanani wekhripto ngokwayo kunokobana imakethe yenze lokho

76.title: Iinomboro Ezingakhangiswa Ngumuntu
76.content:
Angekhe uzibone iinomboro lezi ekhangisweni. Zivela kubalawuli beemali, abangafuna idatha yamambala yama-akhawunti eenkampanini, bese bathumele lokho abakufumeneko.

🇪🇺 I-ESMA, umlawuli we-Europe, ngoMatjhi 2018. Emanarheni we-EU, hlangana kwe-74% ne-89% yama-akhawunti we-CFD wabantu abajayelekileko alahlekelwa yimali. Ukulahlekelwa okulinganiselwako ngekhasimende bekusuka ku-€1,600 ukuya ku-€29,000. I-ESMA yakhawulela umkhiqizo ngenca yalokho.

🇬🇧 I-FCA e-UK, ngoDisemba 2016. Ukuhlaziya kwayo isampuli emele ama-akhawunti wamakhasimende kwafumana bona i-82% yamakhasimende ilahlekelwe yimali kileminkhiqizo.

🇦🇺 I-ASIC e-Australia, kwathunyelwa ngoJanabari 2026, okutjha khulu kwazo zontathu. Emnyakeni weemali we-2024, i-68% yabatjali be-CFD abajayelekileko balahlekelwa yimali, yoke ndawonye ingaphezu kwe-A$458 million. Kileyo, i-A$73 million bekuziimbadelo.

Hlala nomugca wokugcina lowo isikhatjhana. Iingidi ezimatjhumi alikhomba nantathu zayo bezingasi ngitjho kurhweba okumbi. Bekuzizindleko zokudlala: i-spread nawungenako, nemali yokuqashisa ohlangane nayo esifundweni 72.

Abalawuli abathathu abahlukeneko, amanarha amathathu ahlukeneko, idatha ethatha amatjhumi weminyaka amathathu ahlukeneko, begodu ipendulo ihlala iwela hlangana kweengcenye ezimbili kwezintathu neengcenye ezilithoba kwezilitjhumi.

Njesi ingcenye eqakatheke khulu, ngombana yiyo evimba lokhu bona kube yinomboro yokusabisa nje. Abantu labo bebangasi iziphukuphuku. Bebangasi ngamavila. Inengi labo bebabantu abadala abanemisebenzi, begodu abanengi babo bebafunda itjhadi kuhle ukudlula wena njesi. Balahlekelwa ngenca yendlela umkhiqizo owakhiwe ngayo: uthoma ngemva nge-spread, ubhadala irende nawusalindile, begodu i-leverage itjho bona ukutjhukuma okujayelekileko kungakuqeda ngaphambi kobana umbono wakho ube nesikhathi sokuba neliqiniso.

Leso sisakhiwo, ingasi ubutjhapha bobuntu. Begodu iinkhiwo zingahlulwa babantu abazaziko bona zikhona kwaphela. 📊

quiz.explanation: Labo bebabantu abadala abajayelekileko abanemisebenzi, begodu abanengi babo bebafunda itjhadi kuhle ukudlula wena namhlanje. Balahlekelwa ngenca yendlela umkhiqizo osebenza ngayo: uthoma ngemva nge-spread, ubhadala irende qobe busuku nawusalindile, begodu i-leverage itjho bona ukutjhukuma okujayelekileko kungakuqeda ngaphambi kobana umbono wakho ube nesikhathi sokuba neliqiniso. Leso sisakhiwo, ingasi ubutjhapha bobuntu, begodu iinkhiwo zingahlulwa babantu abazaziko bona zikhona.

Abantu abalahlekelwako bebangatjheji, begodu abarhwebi abatjhejako baphephile
Iinkampani eziphikisanako zathumela iinomboro njengokuhlasela kokukhangisa
Ukulahlekelwa okungako kuvela emanarheni angalawulwako

77.title: Okwatjhentjhako Lokha Imithetho Itjhentjha
77.content:
Isifundo 76 sakunikela ukulahlekelwa. Lesi sifundo sikunikela ukuhlolwa, begodu kuyinto eqakatheke khulu kule-modyuli.

Nange abantu abanengi balahlekelwa ngombana abantu abanengi abatjheji, ukutjhentjha imithetho akukafaneli kutjhentjhe litho. Abangatjhejiko bahlala bangatjheji. Akusinjalo?

I-Australia yenza ukuhlola. NgoMatjhi 2021 i-ASIC yakatelela iinvikelo ezithileko kiyo yoke ikampani ye-CFD esebenzela amakhasimende ajayelekileko: imikhawulo ye-leverage, umthetho ojayelekileko wokuvala ngokuzenzakalela, ukuvikelwa kwebhalansi ekgevu, nokulisa iinyengo njengamabhonasi wokutlolisa. Amakhasimende afanako. Iinkampani ezifanako. Iimakethe ezifanako. Kwatjhentjha imithetho kwaphela.

Nakhu i-ASIC ekulinganisileko eenyangeni ezisithandathu zokuthoma. 🔬

📉 Ukulahlekelwa koke kwama-akhawunti ajayelekileko kwehla ngo-91%, kusuka ekulinganisweni kwe-A$372 million ngekota ukuya ku-A$33 million.
📉 Ama-akhawunti ajayelekileko alahlekelwako ehla ngo-51% ngekota.
📉 Ukuvalwa kwe-margin kwehla ngo-87%.
📉 Iinganekwane zebhalansi ekgevu zehla ngo-88%.

Akekho owahlakanipha eenyangeni ezisithandathu. Umklamo watjhentjha, begodu iingcenye ezilithoba kwezilitjhumi zomonakalo zanyamalala nawo.

Izinto ezimbili ziyalandela, begodu kufanele uzithwale zombili.

Kokuthoma: nawulahlekelwa ekurhwebeni kwe-leverage, okunengi kwalokho okwenzeke kuwe bekwakhiwe emkhiqizweni ngaphambi kobana ufike. Lokho akusimvumo yokungatjheji. Libanga lokuhlonipha into leyo.

Kwesibili, begodu le yingcenye enesizo: iinvikelo ezenze umsebenzi zimikhuba ncamashi le-modyuli ebeyikufundisa yona. Isikhundla esincani. Ukuphuma okuzenzakalelako. Iphasi eliqinileko emonakalweni. Umlawuli bekufanele akatelele lezo kiyo yoke imboni bona athole i-91% leyo. Wena ungazikhethela nje. 🛡️

quiz.explanation: Amakhasimende afanako, iinkampani ezifanako, iimakethe ezifanako. Kwatjhentjha imithetho kwaphela, begodu iingcenye ezilithoba kwezilitjhumi zomonakalo zaya nayo. Akekho owahlakanipha eenyangeni ezisithandathu. Iinvikelo ezenze umsebenzi zimikhuba le-modyuli ehlala ikufundisa yona: isikhundla esincani, ukuphuma okuzenzakalelako, nephasi eliqinileko ngaphasi komonakalo. Umlawuli bekufanele azikatelele kiyo yoke imboni. Wena ungazikhethela nje.
options: Abarhwebi be-Australia baziphethe kuhle kunabe-Europe
I-leverage iba phephile nange umlawuli ayiqalile
Imithetho yavimba abantu bona barhwebe, ngalokho bekungekho okulahlekelwako
Inengi lomonakalo belivela emklamweni womkhiqizo

78.title: I-Gap Eyeqa I-Stop Yakho
78.desc: I-stop mlayezo wokuphuma, ingasi intengo ethenjisiweko
78.content:
Sele uhlangene nama-stop-loss esifundweni 19. Nakhu i-leverage ekwenza kiwo.

I-stop-loss mlayezo: 'nange intengo ifika ezingeni leli, ngikhuphe.' Akusiso isivumelwano ngentengo ozayithola. Itjho bona phuma. Ayitjho bona phuma ncamashi lapha.

Isikhathi esinengi umehluko lowo awuqakatheki, ngombana iintengo zitjhukuma ngamagadango amancani begodu i-oda lakho lizaliswa eduze nezinga lakho. Bese ngezinye izikhathi uqakatheka khulu.

📰 Iimakethe ziyavalwa. Iindaba zifika ngo-11pm. Imakethe ivuleka godu iphasi ngo-8% kunalapho ivale khona, begodu ayikhange irhwebe kinanyana ngiyiphi intengo ephakathi. I-stop yakho beyikileyo gap. Iyasebenza lokha kuvulwa godu begodu izaliswa lapho imakethe ikhona isibili, okukhatjhana khulu nezinga obulikhethileko.

Ngaphandle kwe-leverage, lelo lilanga elimbi. Nge-leverage, kungaba yi-akhawunti yoke, ngombana nange isibambiso sakho besincani kune-gap, i-gap idlula ngqo nentengo yakho yokuvalwa ngekani, begodu uvalwa ngaphasi kwezinga injini ebeyilihlosile.

Izinto ezintathu ongazenza ngalokhu, akukho nesinye esibudisi:

1️⃣ Ungathathi i-stop njengesiqinisekiso. Yithathe njengomkhuba omuhle khulu onobuthakathaka bunye obaziwako.
2️⃣ Yazi lokha imakethe yakho ivaliwe nalokho okuhleliweko. Imiphumela yeenkampani, iinqunto zezinga lenzalo nokukhetha ziimgaphi ezitlolwe kudayari.
3️⃣ Lungisa ubukhulu bona i-gap ingekhe ikuqede. Leli livikelo lamambala, begodu siyisifundo esilandelako. I-stop ikuvikela kokujayelekileko. Ubukhulu besikhundla bukuvikela kokungajayelekileko, begodu okungajayelekileko ngikho okuqeda abantu isibili.

Begodu kufanele ukwazi bona ku-app le, njengakunanyana ngiyiphi i-akhawunti ejayelekileko elawulwa kuhle, ukuvikelwa kwebhalansi ekgevu kutjho bona i-gap angekhe ikwehlisele ngaphasi kwe-zero. Ungalahlekelwa yi-akhawunti. Angekhe ugcine ukweleta. 📰

quiz.explanation: I-stop mlayezo wokuphuma, ingasi isithembiso ngentengo ozayithola. Imakethe ayikhange irhwebe hlangana kwe-{c}90 ne-{c}78, ngalokho bekungasekho i-{c}90 yokuthengisa ngayo. I-stop yakho iyasebenza lokha kuvulwa godu begodu izaliswa lapho imakethe ikhona isibili. Ama-stop asakuvikela ekutjhukumeni okujayelekileko. Ukuzivikela ekweqeni okufana nalokhu bubukhulu besikhundla, ingasi i-stop.
options: I-stop yakho izaliswa ku-{c}90, ncamashi lapho uyibeke khona
Uzaliswa eduze ne-{c}78, intengo yokuthoma etholakalako
I-oda liyakhanselwa, ngombana intengo ilitjhiyile
Umhlinzeki ukubhadala i-{c}12 imakethe eyeqileko

79.title: Ubukhulu Kuqala, Bese Ukurhweba
79.desc: Qunta lokho ongakulahlekelwa ngaphambi kobana uqunte lokho ozakuthenga
79.content:
Nansi into ehlukanisa abantu abahlala isikhathi eside nalabo abangahlali, begodu cishe iyadana.

Abathomi bakhetha ukurhweba, bese babala bona bazakufaka malini. Iingcwethi zikwenza ngemva. Ziqunta kuqala bona zizimisele ukulahlekelwa malini, bese zivumela lokho kuqunte bona isikhundla sivunyelwe ukuba sikhulu kangangani.

Umthetho abanengi babo abawusebenzisako: beka engozini i-1% ukuya ku-2% ye-akhawunti ekurhwebeni ngakunye. Ingasi ukubeka isibambiso se-1%. UKUBEKA ENGOZINI i-1%, okutjho lokho ozakulahlekelwa ngikho isibili nange i-stop yakho ithintwa.

Isebenza njani, ngamagadango amathathu:

1️⃣ Khetha ukulahlekelwa kwakho okukhulu khulu. I-akhawunti ye-10,000 NT, ubeka engozini i-1%, ngalokho i-100 NT.
2️⃣ Khetha lapho ungasi neliqiniso khona. Uzakuphuma nange intengo yehla ngo-5% ukusuka lapho ungene khona.
3️⃣ Hlukanisa. I-100 NT yokulahlekelwa okwamukelekako, ebangeni le-stop le-5%, kutjho isikhundla se-2,000 NT. Lobo bubukhulu bakho. Ingasi umuzwa. Kubala.

Tjhentjha i-stop begodu ubukhulu butjhentjha ngokuzenzakalela. I-stop eqinileko ye-2% ikuvumela ube ne-5,000 NT. I-stop ebanzi ye-10% ikukatelela wehlele ku-1,000 NT. Nalukhulu ingozi ekurhwebeni, kufanele kube kuncani khulu, begodu iimbalo zikwenzela lokho bona umuzwa wakho ungatlhogi ukukwenza.

Kubayini i-1%? Ngombana yenza ukulahlekelwa okulandelanako kuphileke. Ukulahlekelwa okulitjhumi okulandelanako ku-1% kukutjhiya ne-90% ye-akhawunti yakho nomuzwa omumbi. Ukulahlekelwa okulitjhumi okulandelanako ku-20% kukutjhiya ne-11% cishe ye-akhawunti yakho ungenandlela yokubuya, begodu sele wazi esifundweni 71 bona ukukhuphuka lokho kumqansa kangangani.

Akekho ophila eemakethe ngokukhetha abaphumelelako. Woke ophilako ukwenza ngokuqinisekisa bona akukho kulahlekelwa okukodwa okungamqeda. 📐

quiz.q: I-akhawunti ye-10,000 NT. Uzakubeka engozini i-1% ekurhwebeni lokhu, begodu uzakuphuma nange intengo yehla ngo-5% ukusuka lapho ungene khona. Hudula uye ebukhulwini besikhundla obuhlonipha lokho.
quiz.explanation: I-1% ye-10,000 NT yi-100 NT, begodu lokho kukhulu khulu ovumele ukukulahlekelwa. I-stop ye-5% itjho i-100 NT ihlukaniswe ngo-5%, okusisikhundla se-2,000 NT. Hudula phezulu begodu isitjengisi sizakutjengisa ubeka engozini ngaphezu kwalokho obukuqunte.

80.title: Kubayini Ukuphumelela Kuzwakala Njengekghono
80.content:
I-leverage ayisiyo kakhulu ikinga lezibalo. Iimbalo zilula. Likinga lehloko, begodu nanti amathathu abamba woke umuntu.

🎯 1. UKUKHETHA NGOMPHUMELA (OUTCOME BIAS): ukuphumelela kuzwakala njengekghono. Uthatha isikhundla esikhulu khulu ngokweqileko, siyasebenza, uzuza okunengi ngentambama yinye, begodu ingqondo yakho itlola bona 'ngikghona lokhu.' Ayikhange itlole lokho okwenzeke isibili, okukobana uthathe ingozi embi wathola umphumela omuhle. Lezo ziinto ezihlukeneko, begodu imakethe izakukubhadala ngokuthaba ngesiqunto esimbi kanengi ngaphambi kobana ibuthelele. Into eyingozi khulu engenzeka kumrhwebi omutjha kuphumelela kokuthoma okulula.

😤 2. UKURHWEBA NGOKUZIPHINDISELA: ufuna ukuyibuyisa, njesi. Uyalahlekelwa, kuyababa, begodu isifiso sivela msinyana. Ngalokho ukhulisa ubukhulu. Njesi ubeka isikhundla sakho esikhulu khulu ngesikhathi ncamashi lapho ukwahlulela kwakho kumbi khulu, ekurhwebeni okukhethe ngombana ubusilingeni kunokobana bekukuhle. Imakethe ayazi bona uphasi begodu ayikweleti litho. Nawuzwa lokhu, ubukhulu obufaneleko yi-zero. Vala i-app.

🕳️ 3. UKUJAMA UKULAHLEKELWA: 'Ngizakubamba nje bekube kubuya.' Lokhu kugqokiswe njengokubekezela, kungebanga lokho kubudisi ukukubona. Ukubekezela luhlelo olwenze ngokuthula ngaphambilini. Ukujama luhlelo olusungule ngemva kobana intengo iye ngokuphambene nawe, begodu ilitjhwayo lilula: ukuphuma kwakho kutjhukumile. Nawuzifumana uhlathulula bona kubayini izinga obulibekile alisilo izinga elifaneleko, lokho akusikuhlaziya okutjha. Yi-ego yakho ithethelela.

Isivikelo sakho koke okuthathu siyafana begodu asinamabala. Qunta koke nawusathobile, kutlole phasi, begodu uthathe uhlobo lwakho oluvela phakathi nokurhweba njengomxoxi ongathembekiko. 🧠

quiz.q: Uthatha isikhundla esikhulu khulu kunokujayelekileko begodu senza inzuzo ekulu ngentambama yinye. Ngiyiphi indlela eneliqiniso khulu yokukufunda lokho?
quiz.explanation: Ingqondo yakho itlola bona ukghona lokhu. Lokho okwenzeke isibili kukobana uthathe ingozi embi begodu imakethe yakubhadala nanyana kunjalo, begodu lezo ziinto ezimbili ezihlukeneko. Imakethe izakubhadala isiqunto esimbi kanengi ngaphambi kobana ibuthelele. Ukuphumelela kokuthoma okulula yinto eyingozi khulu engenzeka kumrhwebi omutjha, ngombana kufundisa isifundo esingasiso begodu kukubhadalisa ngaso ngemva.

Uthathe ingozi embi begodu wathola umphumela omuhle nje

81.title: Umbuzo Weqiniso
81.content:
Uqedile i-modyuli. Nangu umbuzo iinkhangiso ezingakhe ziwubuze.

Kufanele uyisebenzise i-leverage nakancani?

Kwabantu abanengi, isikhathi esinengi, ipendulo yeqiniso ngu-awa. Ingasi ngombana abahlakaniphi ngokwaneleko. Kungenca yakho koke okusezifundweni ezilitjhumi nesihlanu ezidlulileko: uthoma ngemva, ubhadala irende nawusalindile, ukutjhukuma okujayelekileko kungakuqeda ngaphambi kobana kufakazelwe bona uneliqiniso, begodu abalawuli abathathu ababala ama-akhawunti wamambala bahlala bafumana bona iingcenye ezimbili kwezintathu ukuya kwezilithoba kwezilitjhumi zabantu zilahlekelwe.

Kunohlobo lokurhweba lapho ungakhe uthinte nanyana yini kilokhu. Uthenga isheya, uba ngumnikazi wesiqephu senkampani, amadividendi ayafika, isikhathi sisebenzela WENA kunokuphambana nawe, begodu akukho okungakhe kuvale isikhundla sakho ngaphandle kokubuza. Leyo yi-app le yoke eseleko, begodu ayisilo ikhetho elidanisako. Likhetho iimbalo zesifundo 14 ezithi kanengi liyaphumelela. 🌱

Ngalokho nakhu okufanele ukwazi ngaphambi kobana uqunte.

Akukho ku-app le okukhiywe ngemva kwe-leverage. Yoke imincintiswano, woke amabhodi wabaphambili, yoke iindlela ze-XP, yoke imidlalo yesikolo nayo yoke imiklomelo ye-NOOB kuhlala kuvulekile ngokupheleleko kumuntu ongakhe avule ngitjho nesikhundla sinye se-leverage. Awulahlekelwa litho ngokusuka kilekamelo. Akukho jeziso begodu akukho ibheji elilahlekako.

Begodu akukho lapha okukubhadalela ukuphumelela. Uklonyeliswa ngokuqeda izifundo, ngokuphumelela ihlolo, ngokubeka i-stop, ngokuvala ukurhweba okulahlekelwako, nangokutlola ngokuvalwa kwakho ngekani. Awukhe ubhadalelwe inzuzo, isikhundla esikhulu namkha ithamsanqa elilandelanako, ngombana ukukubhadalela lokho bekuzakuba kukufundisa into engasiyo kodwana kubizwa ngokobana yifundo.

Nawuyisebenzisako: yisebenzise kancani, yisebenzise ne-stop, yazi intengo yakho yokuvalwa ngekani ngaphambi kobana ucindezele litho, begodu ungakhe usebenzise imali ongayilahlekelwa. Nawungayisebenzisi, usafundile ukubona umtjhini, obekuyihloso kusukela ekuthomeni. Abantu abadala abanengi abarhweba ngalezi zinto angekhe bakghone ukuhlathulula lokho osandula ukukufunda. 🤔

quiz.q: Ufundako ulahlekelwa yini ngokuqunta bona angakhe avule isikhundla se-leverage ku-app le?
quiz.explanation: Akukho ku-app le okukhiywe ngemva kwe-leverage. Yoke imincintiswano, woke amabhodi wabaphambili, yoke iindlela ze-XP, yoke imidlalo yesikolo nayo yoke imiklomelo ye-NOOB kuhlala kuvulekile kumuntu ongakhe avule ngitjho nesikhundla sinye se-leverage. Akukho jeziso begodu akukho ibheji elilahlekako. Begodu akukho kilekamelo okukubhadalela ukuphumelela: kubhadalela ukuqeda izifundo, ukuphumelela ihlolo, ukubeka i-stop nokuvala ukurhweba okulahlekelwako.

Begodu kule-boss kwaphela, imikhawulo yeenkhundla icinyiwe. Ngehloso. Kanye.

84.title: Okumbi Khulu Kwakho, Kukhethwe Ngaphambili
84.content:
Uyasazi isibambiso, ibizo, ukuvalwa, irende, i-stop ne-gap. Lesi sifundo sibeka ingcenye yokugcina endaweni yayo: soke isikhundla ozakhe usivule siphela ngendlela yinye ncamashi kwezintathu, begodu umdlalo woke kukobana ngubani okhetha ukuthi ngiyiphi.

1️⃣ WENA UYASIVALA. Uthinta inkinobho begodu isikhundla sivalwa ngentengo yemakethe yanje. Kuhlala kutholakala, kisoke isikhundla, kiso soke isimo. Ukuphuma okunengi kufanele kube ngilokhu.

2️⃣ I-ODA OYIBEKILEKO IYASIVALA. Iinhlobo ezimbili, begodu amabizo aqakathekile, ngalokho wafunde kuhle:

• I-ODA YE-STOP-LOSS ikuvala ngokuzenzakalela lokha intengo itjhukuma NGOKUPHAMBENE nawe iye ezingeni olikhethileko: i-sell-stop ngaphasi kwalapho ungene khona ku-long, i-buy-stop ngaphezu kwalapho ungene khona ku-short. Kokumbi khulu kwakho, okuqunywe nawusathobile, isifundo 80 esele sakufundisa bona kungiso kwaphela isikhathi oqunta ngaso nanyana yini kuhle.
• I-ODA YE-TAKE-PROFIT yi-oda lomkhawulo (limit order) lokuvala: ikuvala ngokuzenzakalela emgomweni owukhethileko, lokha intengo itjhukuma IYA NGAKUWE bona iwufikelele. Kungu-'kwanele' wakho, okuqunywe ngaphambi kobana umhawu ube nevowudi. I-oda lomkhawulo lizaliswa ezingeni lakho namkha ngcono, ingasi kumbi.

3️⃣ UMHLINZEKI UYASIVALA. Lokho kukuvalwa ngekani, esifundweni 70. Begodu nansi into okufanele uyitjhise engqondweni: ukuvalwa ngekani akusilo uhlobo le-oda. Angekhe ubeke 'ukurhweba kokuvalwa ngekani'. Akekho ongakwenza. Akusisisetjenziswa sakho; kulokho umhlinzeki akwenzako bona avikele isikweletu sakhe lokha isibambiso sakho sese siphela, nanyana kungiyiphi intengo imakethe eyibhadalako, nanyana usesikolweni namkha ulele.

I-stop-loss nguwe oqunta okumbi khulu kwakho ngaphambili. Ukuvalwa ngekani kulokho okwenzekako lokha ungakwenzanga lokho.

Ama-oda wakho womabili aneqiniso ngendlela efanako, begodu sele ukwazi esifundweni 78: athoma ukusebenza ezingeni lakho begodu azaliswa ngalokho imakethe ekubhadala isibili. I-gap eyeqa i-stop yakho ikuzalisa ngakwelinye ihlangothi lokweqa, okumbi khulu. I-gap edlula i-take-profit yakho nayo ikuzalisa ngakwelinye ihlangothi, okungcono. Iqiniso elifanako, liqale ngeendlela zombili.

Umthetho munye wokubeka, begodu i-app le iyawukatelela ngebanga eskrinini: i-stop yakho kufanele ihlale hlangana kwentengo yanje nentengo yakho yokuvalwa ngekani. I-stop engale kwentengo yokuvalwa ngekani angekhe ikhe isebenze, ngombana umhlinzeki bekazakuvala kuqala, ngalokho i-app iyayala begodu ikutjela bona kubayini.

Iminyango emithathu yokuphuma kikho koke ukurhweba. Emibili yayo inebizo lakho esibanjweni. Ukuphuma ngomunye wayo, ngelanga olikhethileko, ezingeni olikhethe nawusathobile, kulokho i-modyuli le yoke ebeyikufundisa ukukwenza. 🚪
